monsters.name: Scrawny cat
monsters.description: A skinny little furball with sharp claws and a menacing look.

monsters.name: Farmer Maggot
monsters.description: He's lost his dogs. He's had his mushrooms stolen. He's not a happy hobbit!

monsters.name: Martti Ihrasaari
monsters.description: He weighs 127 kg. He is the president of some remote country.

monsters.name: Mathilde, the Science Student
monsters.description:
She loves joking, and she's constantly giggling. A very happy girl.
Beware, it is rumored that Dark God has put a mighty curse on her.

monsters.name: The Princess
monsters.description: The princess of an unknown kingdom, you need to save her!

monsters.name: Hurin Thalion, the Last Lord of Dor-Lomin
monsters.description: A great warrior.

monsters.name: Pitiful-looking Cheezer
monsters.description: You just can't help feeling sorry for him.

monsters.name: Goldfish
monsters.description: Beautiful red fish in ponds.

monsters.name: Carp
monsters.description: Beautiful and expensive fish for ponds.

monsters.name: Forest ghoul
monsters.description: A ghastly appearance breaking out of the nearby woods!

monsters.name: Spook
monsters.description: Did it just float out of that wall behind you?

monsters.name: Rampant zombie
monsters.description: Digging itself out of the earth it is not finding any rest.

monsters.name: Vampire apparition
monsters.description: It's baring its teeth at you!

monsters.name: Lost goblin
monsters.description: This one seems oddly far away from the orc caves.

monsters.name: Moving bones
monsters.description: With rattling noises it unsteadily moves towards you!

monsters.name: Frankenstein's Monster
monsters.description: Shut the windows and bar the doors!

monsters.name: Freddy Krueger
monsters.description: Behold, a nightmare on Greenway!

monsters.name: Chaffinch
monsters.description: Utterly harmless, except when angry.

monsters.name: Wild rabbit
monsters.description:
It is not a carnivore, but will defend itself if you stray too
close.

monsters.name: Woodsman
monsters.description: He has a strong axe with a sharp edge.

monsters.name: Grey mold
monsters.description: A small strange growth.

monsters.name: Large white snake
monsters.description: It is about eight feet long.

monsters.name: Grey mushroom patch
monsters.description: Yum! It looks quite tasty.

monsters.name: Newt
monsters.description: A small, harmless lizard.

monsters.name: Giant white centipede
monsters.description: It is about four feet long and carnivorous.

monsters.name: White icky thing
monsters.description: It is a smallish, slimy, icky creature.

monsters.name: Clear icky thing
monsters.description: It is a smallish, slimy, icky, blobby creature.

monsters.name: Giant white mouse
monsters.description: It is about three feet long with large teeth.

monsters.name: Large brown snake
monsters.description: It is about eight feet long.

monsters.name: Small kobold
monsters.description: It is a small, dog-headed humanoid figure.

monsters.name: White worm mass
monsters.description: It is a large slimy mass of worms.

monsters.name: Floating eye
monsters.description: A disembodied eye, floating a few feet above the ground.

monsters.name: Rock lizard
monsters.description: It is a small lizard with a hardened hide.

monsters.name: Grid bug
monsters.description: A strange electric bug.

monsters.name: Jackal
monsters.description: It is a yapping snarling dog, dangerous when in a pack.

monsters.name: Soldier ant
monsters.description: A large ant with powerful mandibles.

monsters.name: Fruit bat
monsters.description: A fast-moving pest.

monsters.name: Insect swarm
monsters.description:
A lone insect may be harmless, but there's a whole swarm of
them here!

monsters.name: The Geater Hell-Beast
monsters.description: This unholy abomination will crush you. Flee while you can!

monsters.name: Merton Proudfoot, the lost hobbit
monsters.description: The poor hobbit got lost in the dreadful maze!

monsters.name: Moldoux, the Defenceless Mold
monsters.description: A small strange growth. It seems to be defenceless...

monsters.name: Melinda Proudfoot
monsters.description: She seems to seek someone, you may help...

monsters.name: Susceptible test blob
monsters.description: For testing

monsters.name: White wolf cub
monsters.description:
A tiny young wolf from the northern wastes. Its breath is cold and
icy and its fur coated in frost.

monsters.name: Charged test blob
monsters.description: For testing

monsters.name: Robin
monsters.description: A grey-brown bird with orange-red breast feathers.

monsters.name: Summoning test blob
monsters.description: For testing

monsters.name: Everliving test blob
monsters.description: For testing

monsters.name: Everliving target dummy
monsters.description: For testing

monsters.name: Kobold
monsters.description: It is a squat and ugly dog-headed humanoid.

monsters.name: Shrieker mushroom patch
monsters.description: Yum! It looks quite tasty. It doesn't sound so nice, though...

monsters.name: Blubbering icky thing
monsters.description: It is a smallish, slimy, icky, hungry creature.

monsters.name: Novice warrior
monsters.description: He looks inexperienced but tough.

monsters.name: Novice rogue
monsters.description: A rather shifty individual.

monsters.name: Yellow mushroom patch
monsters.description: Yum! It looks quite tasty.

monsters.name: White jelly
monsters.description: It's a large pile of white flesh.

monsters.name: Giant black ant
monsters.description: It is about three feet long.

monsters.name: Salamander
monsters.description: A small black and orange lizard.

monsters.name: White harpy
monsters.description: A flying, screeching bird with a woman's face.

monsters.name: Blue yeek
monsters.description: A small humanoid figure.

monsters.name: Grip, Farmer Maggot's dog
monsters.description:
A rather vicious dog belonging to Farmer Maggot. It thinks you are
stealing mushrooms.

monsters.name: Wolf, Farmer Maggot's dog
monsters.description:
A rather vicious dog belonging to Farmer Maggot. It thinks you are
stealing mushrooms.

monsters.name: Fang, Farmer Maggot's dog
monsters.description:
A rather vicious dog belonging to Farmer Maggot. It thinks you are
stealing mushrooms.

monsters.name: Giant green frog
monsters.description: It is as big as a wolf.

monsters.name: Freesia
monsters.description: A striped housecat who enjoys hunting.

monsters.name: Green worm mass
monsters.description: It is a large slimy mass of worms.

monsters.name: Large yellow snake
monsters.description: It is about ten feet long.

monsters.name: Cave spider
monsters.description: It is a black spider that moves in fits and starts.

monsters.name: Crow
monsters.description: It is a hooded crow, gray except for the black wings and head.

monsters.name: Wild cat
monsters.description:
A larger than normal feline, hissing loudly. Its velvet paws conceal a
fistful of needles.

monsters.name: Giant yellow centipede
monsters.description: It is about four feet long and carnivorous.

monsters.name: Pike
monsters.description: It's a common fresh-water predatory fish.

monsters.name: Metallic green centipede
monsters.description: It is about four feet long and carnivorous.

monsters.name: Novice priest
monsters.description: He is tripping over his priestly robes.

monsters.name: Novice mage
monsters.description: He is leaving behind a trail of dropped spell components.

monsters.name: Smeagol
monsters.description: Usually known as Gollum. He's been sneaking, and he wants his 'precious'.

monsters.name: Green ooze
monsters.description: It's green and it's oozing.

monsters.name: Poltergeist
monsters.description: It is a ghastly, ghostly form.

monsters.name: Yellow jelly
monsters.description: It's a large pile of yellow flesh.

monsters.name: Giant white louse
monsters.description: It is six inches long.

monsters.name: Black naga
monsters.description: A large black serpent's body with a female torso.

monsters.name: Spotted mushroom patch
monsters.description: Yum! It looks quite tasty.

monsters.name: Silver jelly
monsters.description:
It is a large pile of silver flesh that sucks all light from its
surroundings.

monsters.name: Scruffy-looking hobbit
monsters.description:
A short little guy, in bedraggled clothes. He appears to be looking
for a good tavern.

monsters.name: Giant white ant
monsters.description: It is about two feet long and has sharp pincers.

monsters.name: Yellow mold
monsters.description: It is a strange growth on the dungeon floor.

monsters.name: Yellow worm mass
monsters.description: It is a large slimy mass of worms.

monsters.name: Clear worm mass
monsters.description: It is a disgusting mass of poisonous worms.

monsters.name: Radiation eye
monsters.description: A disembodied eye, crackling with energy.

monsters.name: Novice paladin
monsters.description:
An adventurer both devoutly religious and skilful in combat.
He seems to consider you an agent of the devil.

monsters.name: Piranha
monsters.description: Bloodthirsty fish who can smell your blood from a great distance.

monsters.name: Metallic blue centipede
monsters.description: It is about four feet long and carnivorous.

monsters.name: Raven
monsters.description: Larger than a crow, and pitch black.

monsters.name: Yellow light
monsters.description: A fast-moving bright light, apparently totally random in its movement.

monsters.name: Cave lizard
monsters.description: It is an armoured lizard with a powerful bite.

monsters.name: Novice ranger
monsters.description: An agile hunter, ready and relaxed.

monsters.name: Blue jelly
monsters.description: It's a large pile of pulsing blue flesh.

monsters.name: Creeping copper coins
monsters.description:
It appears to be a pile of copper coins, until it starts crawling towards you
on tiny legs.

monsters.name: Giant white rat
monsters.description: It is a very vicious rodent.

monsters.name: Snotling
monsters.description: Immature Orclings, running wild and screaming all the time.

monsters.name: Swordfish
monsters.description: A fish with a swordlike "beak".

monsters.name: Blue worm mass
monsters.description: It is a large slimy mass of worms.

monsters.name: Large grey snake
monsters.description: It is about ten feet long.

monsters.name: Giant crayfish
monsters.description: A man-sized, heavily armoured fresh-water relative of the lobster.

monsters.name: Mermaid
monsters.description:
A green-skinned humanoid with a fishtail. Beware - there are rumours
of adventures losing their minds under the fearsome
charms of mermaids.

monsters.name: Novice mindcrafter
monsters.description: A novice in the arts of mind over matter.

monsters.name: Silver mouse
monsters.description:
It is about three feet long with large teeth. As the light of your lamp falls
on it, it seems to grow stronger.

monsters.name: Metallic red centipede
monsters.description: It is about four feet long and carnivorous.

monsters.name: Skeleton kobold
monsters.description: It is a small animated kobold skeleton.

monsters.name: Green naga
monsters.description:
A large green serpent with a female torso. Her green skin glistens with
acid.

monsters.name: Giant leech
monsters.description: Yech! The disgusting thing only wants your blood!

monsters.name: Barracuda
monsters.description: A predatory fish with razor-sharp teeth.

monsters.name: Zog
monsters.description: Drooling, insectoid aliens with disgusting habits.

monsters.name: Blue ooze
monsters.description: It's blue and it's oozing.

monsters.name: Green glutton ghost
monsters.description: It is a very ugly green ghost with a voracious appetite.

monsters.name: Green jelly
monsters.description: It is a large pile of pulsing green flesh.

monsters.name: Large kobold
monsters.description: It is a man-sized figure with the all too recognizable face of a kobold.

monsters.name: Grey icky thing
monsters.description: It is a smallish, slimy, icky, nasty creature.

monsters.name: Disenchanter eye
monsters.description: A disembodied eye, crackling with magic.

monsters.name: Red worm mass
monsters.description: It is a large slimy mass of worms.

monsters.name: Copperhead snake
monsters.description: It has a copper head and sharp venomous fangs.

monsters.name: Rot jelly
monsters.description:
It is a large pile of rotting flesh, whose touch spoils your food.
The terrible smell it exudes is also very hard to get rid of...

monsters.name: Aquatic kobold
monsters.description: Yes, your favourite denizen of evil also comes in an aquatic variety.

monsters.name: Child spirit
monsters.description: A helpful spirit from beyond the grave.

monsters.name: Blue firelizard
monsters.description:
The ancestors of the Dragons of the Dragonriders, these are
friendly funny flying creatures with the powers of the dragons.

monsters.name: The Blubbering idiot, agent of black market, Simon the weak
monsters.description:
He tends to blubber a lot, he was a simple blubbering idiot before he lost
himself in the dungeon and fell under Morgoth's will.
Now he is a mindless servant of Morgoth. Destroy him - if you can...

monsters.name: Bullroarer the Hobbit
monsters.description:
He is a sturdy hobbit who is renowned for his unusual strength and
vigour. He can prove a troublesome opponent.

monsters.name: Panda
monsters.description: A black and white spotted bear that doesn't seem overly agressive.

monsters.name: Black horse
monsters.description: A domesticated black horse.

monsters.name: Grullo
monsters.description: A domesticated grullo horse.

monsters.name: Grey horse
monsters.description: A domesticated grey horse.

monsters.name: Chestnut horse
monsters.description: A domesticated chestnut horse.

monsters.name: Palomino
monsters.description: A domesticated palomino horse.

monsters.name: Death sword
monsters.description: A bloodthirsty blade lurking for prey. Beware!

monsters.name: Purple mushroom patch
monsters.description: Yuk! It doesn't look so tasty.

monsters.name: Novice warrior
monsters.description: He looks inexperienced but tough.

monsters.name: Nibelung
monsters.description: Night dwarves collecting riches.

monsters.name: The disembodied hand that strangled people
monsters.description: Even today, nobody knows where it lurks...

monsters.name: Brown mold
monsters.description: A strange brown growth on the dungeon floor.

monsters.name: Giant brown bat
monsters.description: It screeches as it attacks.

monsters.name: Rat-thing
monsters.description: A ratlike creature with a humanlike face.

monsters.name: Novice rogue
monsters.description: A rather shifty individual.

monsters.name: Creeping silver coins
monsters.description:
It appears to be a pile of silver coins, until it starts crawling towards you
on tiny legs.

monsters.name: Snaga
monsters.description:
He is one of the many weaker 'slave' orcs, often mistakenly known as a
goblin.

monsters.name: Rattlesnake
monsters.description:
It is recognized by the hard-scaled end of its body that is often rattled
to frighten its prey.

monsters.name: Giant slug
monsters.description:
It is slowly making its way towards you, eating everything in
its path...

monsters.name: Novice mage
monsters.description: He is leaving behind a trail of dropped spell components.

monsters.name: Novice priest
monsters.description: He is tripping over his priestly robes.

monsters.name: Giant pink frog
monsters.description: It looks poisonous.

monsters.name: Dark-elf
monsters.description:
An elven figure with jet black skin and white hair, his eyes are large and
twisted with evil.

monsters.name: Zombified kobold
monsters.description:
It is an animated kobold corpse. Flesh falls off in large chunks as it
shambles forward.

monsters.name: Crypt creep
monsters.description: A frightening skeletal figure in a black robe.

monsters.name: Cave orc
monsters.description: He is often found in huge numbers in deep caves.

monsters.name: Wood spider
monsters.description: It scuttles towards you.

monsters.name: Manes
monsters.description: It is a minor but aggressive demon.

monsters.name: Bloodshot eye
monsters.description: A disembodied eye, bloodshot and nasty.

monsters.name: Red naga
monsters.description: A large red snake with a woman's torso.

monsters.name: Red jelly
monsters.description: It is a large pulsating mound of red flesh.

monsters.name: Green icky thing
monsters.description: It is a smallish, slimy, icky, acidic creature.

monsters.name: Lost soul
monsters.description: It is almost insubstantial.

monsters.name: Night lizard
monsters.description: It is a black lizard with overlapping scales and a powerful jaw.

monsters.name: Mughash, the Kobold Lord
monsters.description: Strong and powerful, for a kobold.

monsters.name: Novice paladin
monsters.description: He thinks you are an agent of the devil.

monsters.name: Bullywug
monsters.description:
A vaguely humanoid creature, it looks like a cross between a hobbit and a
frog.

monsters.name: Giant turtle
monsters.description: A giant turtle with flippers, adapted for life in the ocean.

monsters.name: Green firelizard
monsters.description:
The ancestors of the Dragons of the Dragonriders, these are
friendly funny flying creatures with the powers of the dragons.

monsters.name: Vort the Kobold Queen
monsters.description:
Where Mughash is the strongest of his kind, his consort Vort is the
wisest: she is her tribe's chief shamaness.

monsters.name: Rotting corpse
monsters.description: Corpses awakened from their sleep by dark sorcery.

monsters.name: Skeleton orc
monsters.description: It is an animated orc skeleton.

monsters.name: Nurgling
monsters.description:
It is a minor demon servitor of Nurgle. It looks like a hairless
teddy bear, with twisted eyes and rotting, ghoulish skin.

monsters.name: Lagduf, the Snaga
monsters.description:
A captain of a regiment of weaker orcs, Lagduf keeps his troop in order
with displays of excessive violence.

monsters.name: Brown yeek
monsters.description: It is a strange small humanoid.

monsters.name: Novice ranger
monsters.description: An agile hunter, ready and relaxed.

monsters.name: Giant salamander
monsters.description: A large black and yellow lizard. You'd better run away!

monsters.name: Space monster
monsters.description: A black hole in the fabric of reality.

monsters.name: Carnivorous flying monkey
monsters.description: It looks fantastic, yet frightening.

monsters.name: Green mold
monsters.description: It is a strange growth on the dungeon floor.

monsters.name: Lemure
monsters.description: It is the larval form of a major demon.

monsters.name: Hill orc
monsters.description: He is a hardy well-weathered survivor.

monsters.name: Hunting hawk
monsters.description: Trained to hunt and kill without fear.

monsters.name: Phantom warrior
monsters.description: Spectral creatures that are half real, half illusion.

monsters.name: Gremlin
monsters.description: Don't feed them after midnight!

monsters.name: Bullywug warrior
monsters.description: A member of the frog-people clan. He is wielding a long, sharp shark tooth.

monsters.name: Bullywug shaman
monsters.description:
A leader of a clan of frog-people, he is cloaked in a cloak made of
shark skin.

monsters.name: Novice mindcrafter
monsters.description: A novice in the arts of mind over matter.

monsters.name: Ewok
monsters.description: A cute little bear, full of merchandising potential.

monsters.name: Wormtongue, Agent of Saruman
monsters.description: He's been spying for Saruman. He is a snivelling wretch with no morals.

monsters.name: Yeti
monsters.description: A large white figure covered in shaggy fur.

monsters.name: Bloodshot icky thing
monsters.description: It is a strange, slimy, icky creature.

monsters.name: Giant grey rat
monsters.description: It is a rodent of unusual size.

monsters.name: Black harpy
monsters.description: A woman's face on the body of a vicious black bird.

monsters.name: Skaven
monsters.description:
A mutated rat-creature from the great waste, it is vaguely
humanoid in appearance and walks on its hind legs. This race
serves chaos fervently and is greatly feared by others.

monsters.name: Cave bear
monsters.description:
A large bear appears to have made its home in this cave. It is hungry,
and you are trespassing in its territory.

monsters.name: Rock mole
monsters.description:
Despite its unimpressive size, this mole creature has fangs powerful
enough to bore through solid rock.

monsters.name: Baby blue dragon
monsters.description:
This hatchling dragon is still soft, its eyes unaccustomed to light and
its scales a pale blue.

monsters.name: Baby white dragon
monsters.description:
This hatchling dragon is still soft, its eyes unaccustomed to light and
its scales a pale white.

monsters.name: Baby green dragon
monsters.description:
This hatchling dragon is still soft, its eyes unaccustomed to light and
its scales a sickly green.

monsters.name: Baby black dragon
monsters.description:
This hatchling dragon is still soft, its eyes unaccustomed to light and
its scales a dull black.

monsters.name: Baby red dragon
monsters.description:
This hatchling dragon is still soft, its eyes unaccustomed to light and
its scales a pale red.

monsters.name: Giant red ant
monsters.description: It is large and has venomous mandibles.

monsters.name: Brodda, the Easterling
monsters.description: A nasty piece of work, Brodda picks on defenseless women and children.

monsters.name: Bloodfang, the Wolf
monsters.description: It has been terrorizing the nearby villages.

monsters.name: King cobra
monsters.description: It is a large snake with a hooded face.

monsters.name: War bear
monsters.description: Bears with tusks, trained to kill.

monsters.name: Killer bee
monsters.description: It is poisonous and aggressive.

monsters.name: Baby bronze dragon
monsters.description:
This hatchling dragon is still soft, its eyes unaccustomed to light and
its scales a dull bronze.

monsters.name: Baby gold dragon
monsters.description:
This hatchling dragon is still soft, its eyes unaccustomed to light and
its scales a pale gold.

monsters.name: Aquatic elf
monsters.description:
A sleek form vaguely shaped like a dolphin, except with a humanoid
head and arms. The facial features are decidedly elven.

monsters.name: Baby dragon turtle
monsters.description: A newly-hatched dragon turtle. It still hasn't grown a proper shell.

monsters.name: Baby silver dragon
monsters.description:
This hatchling dragon is still soft, its eyes unaccustomed to light and
its scales a pale silver.

monsters.name: Robin Hood, the Outlaw
monsters.description: The legendary archer steals from the rich (you qualify).

monsters.name: Bandit
monsters.description: He is after your cash!

monsters.name: Giant spider
monsters.description: It is a vast spider whose bulbous body is bloated with poison.

monsters.name: Giant white tick
monsters.description: It is moving slowly towards you.

monsters.name: The Borshin
monsters.description:
Pallid and twisted, this creature hates the very sight of you.
"It looked like something that had started out to be a man but had never
quite made it. It had been stepped on, twisted, had holes poked into the
sickly dough of its head-bulge. Bones showed through the transparent flesh
of its torso and its short legs were as thick as trees, terminating in
disk-shaped pads from which dozens of long toes hung like roots or worms.
its arms were longer than its entire body. it was a crushed slug, a thing
that had been frozen and thawed before it was fully baked. It was -
'It is the Borshin', said the Lord of Bats."

monsters.name: Dark-elven mage
monsters.description: A dark elven figure, dressed all in black, hurling spells at you.

monsters.name: Kamikaze yeek
monsters.description: The evil wizard Bruce has trained them to be living weapons.

monsters.name: Servant of Glaaki
monsters.description:
"...the hand of a corpse -- bloodless and skeletal, and with
impossibly long, cracked nails."

monsters.name: Dark-elven warrior
monsters.description: A dark elven figure in armour, ready with his sword.

monsters.name: Sand-dweller
monsters.description:
"Rough-skinned, large-eyed, large-eared, with a horrible,
distorted resemblance to the koala bear facially, though
his body had an appearance of emaciation."

monsters.name: Clear mushroom patch
monsters.description: Yum! It smells quite tasty. If you could only see it...

monsters.name: Quiver slot
monsters.description:
What looks like the remains of a quiver dropped by a past adventurer
has become overgrown with a strange mold intent on using the contents
of the quiver to grab prey.

monsters.name: Grishnakh, the Hill Orc
monsters.description: He is a cunning and devious orc with a chaotic nature.

monsters.name: Giant tan bat
monsters.description: A giant bat, the beating of whose wings produces a strangely unnerving noise.

monsters.name: Owlbear
monsters.description: A bizarre bear-creature with the claws and the face of an owl.

monsters.name: Blue horror
monsters.description: An ugly screaming little demon servant of Tzeentch.

monsters.name: Hairy mold
monsters.description: It is a strange hairy growth on the dungeon floor.

monsters.name: Disenchanter mold
monsters.description: It is a strange glowing growth on the dungeon floor.

monsters.name: Pseudo dragon
monsters.description: A small relative of the dragon that inhabits dark caves.

monsters.name: Tengu
monsters.description:
It is a fast-moving demon with some remotely bird-like features that blinks
quickly in and out of existence; no other demon matches its teleporting
mastery.

monsters.name: Creeping gold coins
monsters.description:
It appears to be a pile of gold coins, until it starts crawling towards you
on tiny legs.

monsters.name: Wolf
monsters.description: It howls and snaps at you.

monsters.name: Giant fruit fly
monsters.description: A fast-breeding, annoying pest.

monsters.name: Panther
monsters.description:
A large black cat, stalking you with intent. It thinks you're its next
meal.

monsters.name: Brigand
monsters.description: He is eyeing your backpack.

monsters.name: Hobbes the Tiger
monsters.description: Fast-moving, with a taste for tuna sandwiches.

monsters.name: Shadow creature of Fiona
monsters.description:
"There was something unusual about their appearance... For one thing,
all had uniformly bloodshot eyes. Very, very bloodshot eyes. With them,
though, the condition seemed normal. For another, all had an extra joint
to each finger and thumb, and sharp, forward-curving spurs on the backs
of their hands. All of them had prominent jaws and forty-four teeth,
most of them longer than human teeth, and several looking to be much
sharper. Their flesh was grayish and hard and shiny. There were
undoubtedly other differences also, but those were sufficient to prove
a point of some sort."

monsters.name: Undead mass
monsters.description:
A sickening mound of decaying flesh, bones, hands and so on. It seems to
be growing.

monsters.name: Tangleweed
monsters.description:
A mass of vegetation. As you pass near it, it reaches out tendrils to
ensnare you. You can just make out skeletons of its previous victims
deep within the thickets.

monsters.name: Poison ivy
monsters.description: A mass of vegetation. It seems to be growing...

monsters.name: Human warrior
monsters.description:
They are used as the main assault force of the human kings.
They will help you in some quests.

monsters.name: The Variant Maintainer
monsters.description: A deranged programmer, scattering bizarre ideas and bad code everywhere.

monsters.name: Random number generator
monsters.description:
A feared creation of the Variant Maintainer, it tries to generate Morgoth
in the town and the One Ring in the magic shop.

monsters.name: Box jellyfish
monsters.description: A strange water creature, whose touch can be deadly.

monsters.name: Giant piranha
monsters.description: A very large and bloodthirsty fish.

monsters.name: Sand mite
monsters.description:
A relative of crabs and shrimp, this is a tiny creature that inhabits sandy
bottoms. It has a pair of dangerous-looking claws.

monsters.name: Aquatic elven warrior
monsters.description: An aquatic elf trained in all forms of combat.

monsters.name: Aquatic elven shaman
monsters.description:
A wizened aquatic elf skilled in the magical arts. You can see an
irridescent film coating the water around him.

monsters.name: Young spirit
monsters.description: A helpful spirit from beyond the grave.

monsters.name: Brown firelizard
monsters.description:
The ancestors of the Dragons of the Dragonriders, these are
friendly funny flying creatures with the powers of the dragons.

monsters.name: Novice possessor (soul)
monsters.description: It does not look that powerful.

monsters.name: Jan, the Minimite
monsters.description:
Small winged jolly annoying chatterbox, actually he is a descendant
of dispersed minimite race.

monsters.name: Orfax, Son of Boldor
monsters.description:
He's just like his daddy! He knows mighty spells, but fortunately he is a
yeek.

monsters.name: Chaos shapechanger
monsters.description: A vaguely humanoid form constantly changing its appearance.

monsters.name: Baby multi-hued dragon
monsters.description:
This hatchling dragon is still soft, its eyes unaccustomed to light and
its scales shimmering with a hint of colour.

monsters.name: Vorpal bunny
monsters.description:
It looks very cute, except for the razor sharp teeth. It moans
ominously as it jumps at your throat!

monsters.name: Hippocampus
monsters.description: A truly strange hybrid of a horse and a fish.

monsters.name: Zombified orc
monsters.description: It is a shambling orcish corpse leaving behind a trail of flesh.

monsters.name: Hippogriff
monsters.description: A strange hybrid of eagle and horse. It looks weird.

monsters.name: Drowned soul
monsters.description:
A ghastly victim of drowning, forever doomed to wander the ocean waters
looking for revenge.

monsters.name: The wounded bear
monsters.description: A wounded bear, who has occasionally attacked humans.

monsters.name: Eagle
monsters.description: A magnificent huge predatory bird.

monsters.name: Black mamba
monsters.description: It has glistening black skin, a sleek body, and highly venomous fangs.

monsters.name: White wolf
monsters.description:
A large and muscled wolf from the northern wastes. Its breath is cold and
icy and its fur coated in frost.

monsters.name: Grape jelly
monsters.description: Yum! It looks quite tasty. It is a pulsing mound of glowing flesh.

monsters.name: Nether worm mass
monsters.description:
It is a disgusting mass of dark worms, eating each other, the floor,
the air, you...

monsters.name: Abyss worm mass
monsters.description: Even more disgusting dark worms, their essence that of unbeing.

monsters.name: Golfimbul, the Hill Orc Chief
monsters.description: A leader of a band of raiding orcs, he picks on hobbits.

monsters.name: Swordsman
monsters.description: A warrior of considerable skill.

monsters.name: Skaven shaman
monsters.description:
The shaman of a skaven tribe gets his powers from a mystic
stone corrupted by chaos, called a Warp Stone.

monsters.name: Mine-dog
monsters.description:
An explosive charge has been attached to this poor animal, who
has been trained to search for its target and detonate.

monsters.name: Hellcat
monsters.description: It is as large as a tiger, and its yellow eyes are pupilless.

monsters.name: Moon beast
monsters.description:
"Great greyish-white slippery things which could expand and
contract at will, and whose principle shape... was that of a
sort of toad without any eyes, but with a curious vibrating mass
of short pink tentacles on the end of its blung, vague snout."

monsters.name: Master yeek
monsters.description: A small humanoid that radiates some power.

monsters.name: Priest
monsters.description: A robed man dedicated to his god.

monsters.name: Dark-elven priest
monsters.description:
A dark elven figure, dressed all in black, chanting curses and waiting to
deliver your soul to hell.

monsters.name: Air spirit
monsters.description: A whirlwind of sentient air.

monsters.name: Skeleton human
monsters.description: It is an animated human skeleton.

monsters.name: Zombified human
monsters.description: It is a shambling human corpse dropping chunks of flesh behind it.

monsters.name: Tiger
monsters.description:
One of the largest of its species, a sleek orange and black shape creeps
towards you, ready to pounce.

monsters.name: Moaning spirit
monsters.description: A ghostly apparition that shrieks horribly.

monsters.name: Stegocentipede
monsters.description: It is a vast armoured centipede with massive mandibles and a spiked tail.

monsters.name: Spotted jelly
monsters.description: A strange jelly thing, covered in discoloured blotches.

monsters.name: Tiger shark
monsters.description: A small species of shark, although the teeth are still as deadly.

monsters.name: Devilfish
monsters.description:
A disgusting fish, it has a large gaping mouth and a small lantern dangling
from an outgrowth on its head.

monsters.name: Ixitxachitl
monsters.description: An intelligent devil ray of the depths.

monsters.name: Electric eye
monsters.description:
A disembodied eye, floating a few feet above the ground, lightning cracking
around the metallic surface, the tearless retina tracing everything you do.

monsters.name: Drider
monsters.description: A dark elven torso merged with the bloated form of a giant spider.

monsters.name: Mongbat
monsters.description: Devil-bats, notoriously difficult to kill.

monsters.name: Killer brown beetle
monsters.description: It is a vicious insect with a tough carapace.

monsters.name: Ogre
monsters.description: A hideous, smallish giant that is often found near or with orcs.

monsters.name: Creeping mithril coins
monsters.description:
It appears to be a pile of sentient mithril coins that doesn't like being
picked up.

monsters.name: Illusionist
monsters.description: A deceptive spell caster.

monsters.name: Druid
monsters.description: A priest devoted to Nature.

monsters.name: Pink horror
monsters.description: An ugly screaming little demon servant of Tzeentch.

monsters.name: Cloaker
monsters.description: It resembles a normal cloak until some poor fool ventures too close!

monsters.name: Black orc
monsters.description: He is a large orc with powerful arms and deep black skin.

monsters.name: Ochre jelly
monsters.description:
A fast moving highly acidic jelly thing, that is eating away the floor it
rests on.

monsters.name: Flounder
monsters.description:
A flattened fish which is able to change body coloring for
camouflage.

monsters.name: Bronze firelizard
monsters.description:
The ancestors of the Dragons of the Dragonriders, these are
friendly funny flying creatures with the powers of the dragons.

monsters.name: Gunfish
monsters.description: A fish that hunts with jet of water.

monsters.name: Software bug
monsters.description: Oh no! They are everywhere!

monsters.name: Lurker
monsters.description:
A strange creature that merges with the dungeon floor, trapping its
victims by enveloping them within its perfectly disguised form.

monsters.name: Vlasta
monsters.description:
This strange creature looks like a miniature tyrannosaur. It has
empty, pale eyes and a sharp beak, which it aims at your eyes
as it jumps at you!

monsters.name: Giant white dragon fly
monsters.description: It is a large fly that drips frost.

monsters.name: Snaga sapper
monsters.description:
He is one of the many weaker 'slave' orcs, often mistakenly known as a
goblin. He is equipped with an explosive charge.

monsters.name: Blue icky thing
monsters.description:
It is a strange, slimy, icky creature, with rudimentary intelligence,
but evil cunning. It hungers for food, and you look tasty.

monsters.name: Gibbering mouther
monsters.description: A chaotic mass of pulsating flesh, mouths and eyes.

monsters.name: Wolfhound of Flora
monsters.description: Well-trained watchdogs, obedient to death.

monsters.name: Flesh golem
monsters.description: A shambling humanoid monster with long scars.

monsters.name: Cheerful leprechaun
monsters.description: A merry little gnome.

monsters.name: Giant flea
monsters.description: It makes you itch just to look at it.

monsters.name: Ufthak of Cirith Ungol
monsters.description:
A strong orc guarding the pass of Cirith Ungol. He is mortally afraid of
spiders: he was captured by Shelob once, but escaped when she forgot
completely about him.

monsters.name: Giant black louse
monsters.description: It is six inches long.

monsters.name: Boldor, King of the Yeeks
monsters.description: A great yeek, powerful in magic and sorcery, but a yeek all the same.

monsters.name: Clay golem
monsters.description: It is a massive animated statue made out of hardened clay.

monsters.name: Black ogre
monsters.description: A massive orc-like figure with black skin and powerful arms.

monsters.name: Dweller on the threshold
monsters.description: A gorilla-shaped arcane guardian with an appetite for mages.

monsters.name: Half-orc
monsters.description:
He is a hideous deformed cross-breed with man and orc, combining man's
strength and cunning with orcish evil. The traitorous wizard Saruman is
generally believed to be responsible for this abomination.

monsters.name: Dark naga
monsters.description: A giant snake-like figure with a woman's torso, talented in magic.

monsters.name: Magic mushroom patch
monsters.description: Yum! It looks quite tasty. It seems to glow with an unusual light.

monsters.name: Plaguebearer of Nurgle
monsters.description:
An unfortunate individual, who was killed by the incurable
disease known as Nurgle's Rot, and was transformed into a
rotting demon zombie. It has but one eye, and a single
pale horn in its forehead.

monsters.name: Guardian naga
monsters.description: A giant snake-like figure with a woman's torso.

monsters.name: Wererat
monsters.description:
A large rat with glowing red eyes, which can also assume human form. The
wererat is a disgusting creature, relishing in filth and disease.

monsters.name: Light hound
monsters.description: A brilliant canine form whose light hurts your eyes, even at this distance.

monsters.name: Dark hound
monsters.description:
A hole in the air in the shape of a huge hound. No light falls upon its
form.

monsters.name: Flying skull
monsters.description: A pack of skulls animated by necromantic spells.

monsters.name: Mi-Go
monsters.description:
"They were pinkish things about five feet long; with crustaceous
bodies bearing vast pairs of dorsal fins or membranous wings and
several sets of articulate limbs, and with a sort of convoluted
ellipsoid, covered with multitudes of very short antenna, where
a head would ordinarily be..."

monsters.name: Giant tarantula
monsters.description: A giant spider with hairy black and red legs.

monsters.name: Giant clear centipede
monsters.description: It is about four feet long and carnivorous.

monsters.name: Mirkwood spider
monsters.description:
A strong and powerful spider from Mirkwood forest. Cunning and evil, it
seeks to taste your juicy insides.

monsters.name: Griffon
monsters.description: It is half lion, half eagle. It flies menacingly towards you.

monsters.name: Homunculus
monsters.description: It is a small demonic spirit full of malevolence.

monsters.name: Gnome mage
monsters.description: A mage of short stature.

monsters.name: Clear hound
monsters.description: A faint sense of motion in the air, hound shaped, stands before you.

monsters.name: Giant Venus flytrap
monsters.description:
A carnivorous plant that is difficult to detect, until it suddenly snaps shut
around its prey and releases paralyzing enzymes to stop its struggles.

monsters.name: Dwarven warrior
monsters.description:
They are used as the main assault force of the dwarven kings.
They will help you in some quests.

monsters.name: Octopus
monsters.description: It doesn't move very fast, but when it does - watch out!

monsters.name: Undead devilfish
monsters.description: A devilfish brought back from the dead.

monsters.name: Gold firelizard
monsters.description:
The ancestors of the Dragons of the Dragonriders, these are
friendly funny flying creatures with the powers of the dragons.

monsters.name: Positivist
monsters.description: This guy tends to look at everything with suspicion.

monsters.name: Unmagic mushroom patch
monsters.description: Yum! It looks quite tasty. It seems to glow with an unusual light.

monsters.name: Candlebearer
monsters.description: Lesser herald of light, which must be slain to walk the path of corruption.

monsters.name: Darkling
monsters.description:
Lesser herald of darkness, which must be slain to walk the path of
enlightenment.

monsters.name: Grizzly bear
monsters.description: A huge, beastly bear, more savage than most of its kind.

monsters.name: Warg
monsters.description: It is a large wolf with eyes full of cunning.

monsters.name: Umber hulk
monsters.description:
This bizarre creature has glaring eyes and large mandibles capable of
slicing through rock.

monsters.name: Rust monster
monsters.description:
It is a weird, small animal with two antennae popping forth from
its forehead. It looks hungry.

monsters.name: Ogrillon
monsters.description: An unholy hybrid of ogre and orc.

monsters.name: Gelatinous cube
monsters.description:
It is a strange, vast gelatinous structure that assumes cubic proportions
as it lines all four walls of the corridors it patrols. Through its
transparent jelly structure you can see treasures it has engulfed, and a
few corpses as well.

monsters.name: Giant green dragon fly
monsters.description: A vast, foul-smelling dragonfly.

monsters.name: Hummerhorn
monsters.description: A giant buzzing wasp, its stinger drips venom.

monsters.name: Lizard man
monsters.description: Intelligent lizard beings from the depths.

monsters.name: Ulfast, Son of Ulfang
monsters.description: A short and swarthy Easterling.

monsters.name: Crebain
monsters.description:
A type of crow, specially bred by the forces of evil as spies; their
rudimentary intelligence guided by an evil mind has tracked you down,
and now they seek to alert other evil creatures to your presence.

monsters.name: Quasit
monsters.description: The chaotic evil master's favourite pet.

monsters.name: Uruk
monsters.description:
It is a cunning orc of power, as tall as a man, and stronger. It fears
little.

monsters.name: Hammerhead shark
monsters.description: A hungry shark with a strange head.

monsters.name: Sphinx
monsters.description: It will eat you if you cannot answer its riddle.

monsters.name: Imp
monsters.description: The lawful evil master's favourite pet.

monsters.name: Forest troll
monsters.description: He is green-skinned and ugly.

monsters.name: Freezing sphere
monsters.description: A semi-sentient snowball, hurling itself at targets at random.

monsters.name: Jumping fireball
monsters.description: A semi-sentient fireball that moves around randomly.

monsters.name: Ball lightning
monsters.description: A crackling ball of energy, zooming about seemingly at random.

monsters.name: 2-headed hydra
monsters.description: A strange reptilian creature with two heads, guarding its hoard.

monsters.name: Swamp thing
monsters.description: A creature that was once human, but is now as green as moss.

monsters.name: Water spirit
monsters.description: A whirlpool of sentient liquid.

monsters.name: Giant red scorpion
monsters.description: It is fast and poisonous.

monsters.name: Earth spirit
monsters.description: A whirling form of sentient rock.

monsters.name: Nar, the Dwarf
monsters.description:
The friend and companion of the dwarven king Thror, he went mad with
grief after Thror's death at the hands of Azog the Orc. With torn beard
and ragged clothes, he seems to have fixed on you as a convenient target
to vent his anger.

monsters.name: Cultist
monsters.description: A robed humanoid dedicated to a demonic outer god.

monsters.name: Evil eye
monsters.description:
A huge disembodied eye. As you stare into the black nothingness of its pupil,
you feel your will and vitality draining away, and are unable to do anything
except approach it in horrified fascination.

monsters.name: Fire spirit
monsters.description: A whirlwind of sentient flame.

monsters.name: Fire hound
monsters.description:
Flames lick at its feet and its tongue is a blade of fire. You can feel a
furnace heat radiating from the creature.

monsters.name: Cold hound
monsters.description:
A hound as tall as a man, this creature appears to be composed of angular
planes of ice. Cold radiates from it and freezes your breath in the air.

monsters.name: Energy hound
monsters.description:
Saint Elmo's Fire forms a ghostly halo around this hound, and sparks sting
your fingers as energy builds up in the air around you.

monsters.name: Lesser mimic
monsters.description:
A strange creature that disguises itself as some object to lure
unsuspecting adventurers within reach of its venomous claws.

monsters.name: Door mimic
monsters.description:
A strange creature that disguises itself as a door to lure
unsuspecting adventurers within reach of its venomous claws.

monsters.name: Blink dog
monsters.description:
A strange magical member of the canine race, its form seems to shimmer and
fade in front of your very eyes.

monsters.name: Shambling mound
monsters.description:
A pile of rotting vegetation that slides towards you with a disgusting
stench, waking all it nears.

monsters.name: Chaos beastman
monsters.description:
A truly loathsome thing, twisted by chaos, it is a mixture
of several different kinds of creature.

monsters.name: Daemonette of Slaanesh
monsters.description:
It is minor female demon, vaguely human-like, but with crab-like
pincers instead of hands. She wears a rather indecent skimpy
leather bikini, moves quickly and casts deadly spells!

monsters.name: Giant bronze dragon fly
monsters.description: This vast gleaming bronze fly has wings which beat mesmerically fast.

monsters.name: Stunwall
monsters.description: A sentient section of wall.

monsters.name: White shark
monsters.description:
A fast-moving hunter of the depths. When this creature moves,
everybody in the water is in danger!

monsters.name: The Rat King
monsters.description: A massive rat. He's the leader of the pack.

monsters.name: Shagrat, the Orc Captain
monsters.description:
He is an orc of power and great cunning, leader of the garrison at Cirith
Ungol.

monsters.name: Gorbag, the Orc Captain
monsters.description:
He is an orc of power and great cunning, leader of the garrison at Minas
Morgul.

monsters.name: Stone golem
monsters.description: It is a massive animated statue.

monsters.name: Red mold
monsters.description:
It is a strange red growth on the dungeon floor; it seems to burn with
flame.

monsters.name: Neekerbreeker
monsters.description:
Believed to be an evil relative of the cricket, this creature gets its name
from its incessant squeaking, which can best be described as "neek-breek,
neek-breek". The noise can drive people frantic, and worse still, can be
heard for quite some distance, alerting other monsters to your presence.

monsters.name: Huorn
monsters.description:
A very strong near-sentient tree, which has become hostile to other living
things.

monsters.name: Aquatic golem
monsters.description:
An ingenious gnomish invention -- a golem designed for underwater
usage.

monsters.name: Ixitxachitl priest
monsters.description: A devil-ray of the depths, with priestly magic.

monsters.name: Mindcrafter
monsters.description:
A master of the mental arts, able to damage or dominate the
minds of others.

monsters.name: Hill giant
monsters.description: A ten foot tall humanoid with powerful muscles.

monsters.name: Giant black dragon fly
monsters.description: The size of a large bird, this fly drips caustic acid.

monsters.name: Bolg, Son of Azog
monsters.description:
A large and powerful orc, he looks just like his father. He is tall and
fast, but fortunately blessed with orcish brains.

monsters.name: Phase spider
monsters.description:
A spider that never seems quite there. Everywhere you look it is just
half-seen in the corner of one eye.

monsters.name: Lizard king
monsters.description: A lizardman leader.

monsters.name: Landmine
monsters.description: It was left here to be used against intruders.

monsters.name: Great eagle
monsters.description:
Greater and more intelligent than most of its kind, this great eagle is
a messenger between the forces of good.

monsters.name: Livingstone
monsters.description: A sentient section of wall.

monsters.name: Earth hound
monsters.description:
A beautiful crystalline shape does not disguise the danger this hound
clearly presents. Your flesh tingles as it approaches.

monsters.name: Air hound
monsters.description:
Swirling vapours surround this beast as it floats towards you, seemingly
walking on air. Noxious gases sting your throat.

monsters.name: Sabre-tooth tiger
monsters.description:
A fierce and dangerous cat, its huge tusks and sharp claws would lacerate
even the strongest armour.

monsters.name: Acid hound
monsters.description:
Footprints are burned in the ground behind this hound as it pads
around the dungeon. An acrid smell of acid rises from the dog's pelt.

monsters.name: Chimaera
monsters.description:
It is a strange concoction of goat, lion and dragon, with the heads of all
three beasts.

monsters.name: Quylthulg
monsters.description: It is a strange pulsing mound of flesh.

monsters.name: Sasquatch
monsters.description: A tall shaggy, furry humanoid, it could call the yeti brother.

monsters.name: Weir
monsters.description: It is a tracker; half human, half beast.

monsters.name: Ranger
monsters.description:
A warrior who is at one with nature. A master of both bow and sword, with
minor spellcasting skills.

monsters.name: Paladin
monsters.description:
A warrior for a holy cause. Unfortunately, his god is not yours, and there is
rivalry even between the various gods of Good, so he is your enemy.

monsters.name: Werewolf
monsters.description: It is a huge wolf with eyes that glow with manly intelligence.

monsters.name: Dark-elven lord
monsters.description: A dark elven figure in armour and radiating evil power.

monsters.name: Elven archer
monsters.description:
They are used as the main assault force of the elven kings.
They will help you in some quests.

monsters.name: Elite uruk
monsters.description:
It is a cunning orc of power, taller than a man, and stronger. It fears
little.

monsters.name: The Icky Queen
monsters.description: And you thought her offspring were icky!

monsters.name: Electric eel
monsters.description: This serpentine creature can create a deadly voltage. Better watch out!

monsters.name: Whale
monsters.description:
Although it looks like a fish and lives in water, it is in fact
a mammal. And it is huge!

monsters.name: Aquatic hound
monsters.description:
A dog with a finned tail and large, muscular flippers for hind legs.
It has a rubbery skin instead of fur.

monsters.name: Bronze dragon worm
monsters.description:
You thought dragons used eggs, but this worm has the scales, and the bad
breath, and the fiery eyes, of a real Dragon. Its scales glitter in
a multitude of perplexing and distracting ways.

monsters.name: Gold dragon worm
monsters.description:
You thought dragons used eggs, but this worm has the scales, and the bad
breath, and the fiery eyes, of a real Dragon. You can feel the air itself
vibrating as you near it.

monsters.name: 3-headed hydra
monsters.description: A strange reptilian creature with three heads, guarding its hoard.

monsters.name: Blue dragon worm
monsters.description:
You thought dragons used eggs, but this worm has the scales, and the bad
breath, and the fiery eyes, of a real Dragon. Sparks fly from its jaws.

monsters.name: White dragon worm
monsters.description:
You thought dragons used eggs, but this worm has the scales, and the bad
breath, and the fiery eyes, of a real Dragon. Its breath condenses in the air.

monsters.name: Green dragon worm
monsters.description:
You thought dragons used eggs, but this worm has the scales, and the bad
breath, and the fiery eyes, of a real Dragon. You can smell foul gases
on its breath.

monsters.name: Black dragon worm
monsters.description:
You thought dragons used eggs, but this worm has the scales, and the bad
breath, and the fiery eyes, of a real Dragon. Acidic drool drips from its jaws.

monsters.name: Red dragon worm
monsters.description:
You thought dragons used eggs, but this worm has the scales, and the bad
breath, and the fiery eyes, of a real Dragon. Smoke comes from its mouth.

monsters.name: Unbeliever
monsters.description: A scarred warrior who moves with strange confidence.

monsters.name: Ugluk, the Uruk
monsters.description: A strong and cunning orc warrior, the commander of Saruman's orcish horde.

monsters.name: Blue dragon bat
monsters.description: It is a glowing blue bat with a sharp tail.

monsters.name: Mimic
monsters.description:
A strange creature that disguises itself as an object to lure
unsuspecting adventurers within reach of its venomous claws.

monsters.name: Fire vortex
monsters.description: A whirling maelstrom of fire.

monsters.name: Acid vortex
monsters.description: A caustic spinning whirlpool of foaming, steaming water.

monsters.name: Lugdush, the Uruk
monsters.description: A large and powerful orc, captain of one of Saruman's orcish regiments.

monsters.name: Arch-vile
monsters.description:
A pale, corpse-like lesser demon, who moves very fast and spawns evil
everywhere.

monsters.name: Cold vortex
monsters.description: A twisting whirlpool of frost.

monsters.name: Energy vortex
monsters.description: A shimmering tornado of air, sparks crackle along its length.

monsters.name: Globefish
monsters.description: This fish is among the most poisonous creatures there are.

monsters.name: Mummified orc
monsters.description: It is an orcish figure covered in wrappings.

monsters.name: Hill troll
monsters.description: A large troll with an extremely tough and warty hide.

monsters.name: Stargazer
monsters.description:
A giant fish shaped like a flounder. There are two enormous eyes
occupying half of the creature's body.

monsters.name: Giant gold dragon fly
monsters.description:
Large beating wings support this dazzling insect. A loud buzzing noise
pervades the air.

monsters.name: Wyvern
monsters.description: A fast-moving and deadly draconian animal. Beware its poisonous sting!

monsters.name: Serpent man
monsters.description:
"They walked lithely and sinnously erect on pre-mammalian
members, their pied and hairless bodies bending with great
suppleness. There was a loud hissing of formulae as they
went to and fro."

monsters.name: Vampiric mist
monsters.description: A cloud of evil, sentient mist.

monsters.name: Killer stag beetle
monsters.description: It is a giant beetle with vicious claws.

monsters.name: Iron golem
monsters.description: It is a massive metal statue that moves steadily towards you.

monsters.name: Auto-roller
monsters.description: It looks like a huge spiked roller, moving on its own towards you.

monsters.name: Giant yellow scorpion
monsters.description: It is a giant scorpion with a sharp stinger.

monsters.name: Sandworm
monsters.description: Offbreed of the Sandworm Queen, they are harmless alone...

monsters.name: Sirene
monsters.description:
A half-humanoid, half-bird spirit of the ocean, whose song charms
mortals into her bed... under the water.

monsters.name: Dark mist
monsters.description: A pitch-dark cloud of evil, sentient mist.

monsters.name: Frost giant
monsters.description: A twelve foot tall giant covered in furs.

monsters.name: Jade monk
monsters.description: A monk trained in martial arts.

monsters.name: Black ooze
monsters.description: It is a strangely moving puddle.

monsters.name: Hardened warrior
monsters.description: A scarred warrior who moves with confidence.

monsters.name: Azog, King of the Uruk-Hai
monsters.description:
He is also known as the King of Khazad-dum. His ego is renowned to be
bigger than his head.

monsters.name: Dark-elven warlock
monsters.description: A dark elven mage with spells of frightening destructive power.

monsters.name: Master rogue
monsters.description: A thief of great power and shifty speed.

monsters.name: Red dragon bat
monsters.description: It is a sharp-tailed bat, wreathed in fire.

monsters.name: Killer white beetle
monsters.description: It is looking for prey.

monsters.name: Ice skeleton
monsters.description: It is a skeleton covered in frost.

monsters.name: Giant silver ant
monsters.description: A giant silver ant with a caustic bite.

monsters.name: The Queen Ant
monsters.description: She's upset because you hurt her children.

monsters.name: Multi-hued dragon worm
monsters.description:
You thought dragons used eggs, but this worm has the scales, and the bad
breath, and the fiery eyes, of a real Dragon. Its scales shimmer different
colours as you watch.

monsters.name: Giant firefly
monsters.description:
Clouds of these monsters light up the dungeon - so brightly that you can
barely see through them.

monsters.name: Angamaite of Umbar
monsters.description: A Black Numenorean who hates the men of the west.

monsters.name: Forest wight
monsters.description: It is a ghostly apparition with a humanoid form.

monsters.name: Khim, Son of Mim
monsters.description:
One of the last of the Petty-Dwarves. Khim is a tricky sorcerous little
being, full of mischief.

monsters.name: Ibun, Son of Mim
monsters.description:
One of the last of the Petty-Dwarves. Ibun is a tricky sorcerous little
being, full of mischief.

monsters.name: Meneldor the Swift
monsters.description:
Among all the eagles of Middle-earth he is the swiftest, and in his time
has borne messages between all of the Wise. It was Meneldor who bore the
Ring-bearer away from the destruction of Mount Doom.

monsters.name: Phantom beast
monsters.description: A creature that is half real, half illusion.

monsters.name: 4-headed hydra
monsters.description: A strange reptilian creature with four heads, guarding its hoard.

monsters.name: Lesser hell-beast
monsters.description: This creature just might crush you.

monsters.name: Tyrannosaur
monsters.description: A horror from prehistory, reawakened by chaos.

monsters.name: Mummified human
monsters.description: It is a human form encased in mouldy wrappings.

monsters.name: Vampire bat
monsters.description: A blood-sucking bat that flies at your neck hungrily.

monsters.name: Sangahyando of Umbar
monsters.description: A Black Numenorean with a blacker heart.

monsters.name: It
monsters.description: Nobody has ever seen It.

monsters.name: Banshee
monsters.description: It is a ghostly woman's form that wails mournfully.

monsters.name: Gwaihir the Windlord
monsters.description:
The greatest of eagles in the Third Age of Middle-earth, Gwaihir rescued
Gandalf the Wizard from Orthanc, and has twice brought his flock to the
aid of Sauron's enemies in battle - first outside the gates of Erebor in
the Battle of Five Armies, and then before the Black Gate of Mordor itself.

monsters.name: Werebear
monsters.description:
In the eyes of this bear, there glimmers the faintest light of intelligence.
And then its form begins to change... The combination of animal cunning,
human intelligence and the great physical strength of the bear makes for
a dangerous enemy.

monsters.name: Great white shark
monsters.description: A very large carnivorous fish.

monsters.name: Water naga
monsters.description:
A naga adapted to underwater life. She has a fish-like tail and a pair
of gills.

monsters.name: Old Man Willow
monsters.description:
The ancient grey willow tree, ruler of the Old Forest. He despises
trespassers in his territory. "...a huge willow-tree, old and hoary.
Enormous it looked, its sprawling branches going up like racing arms
with many long-fingered hands, its knotted and twisted trunk gaping in
wide fissures that creaked faintly as the boughs moved."

monsters.name: Fire giant
monsters.description: A glowing fourteen foot tall giant. Flames drip from its red skin.

monsters.name: Carrion crawler
monsters.description:
A hideous centipede covered in slime and with glowing tentacles around its
head.

monsters.name: Xiclotlan
monsters.description:
"...a metallically grey tree... about sixteen feet high with
very thick cylindrical branches... cylinders further
divided into six flat circular extensions... and from the top
of what I had taken for a trunk rose a featureless oval... an
orifice gaping at the top."

monsters.name: Pukelman
monsters.description: A stumpy figure carved from stone, with glittering eyes.

monsters.name: Disenchanter beast
monsters.description:
It looks like an anteater, and there is a static feeling
crackling around its long trunk.

monsters.name: Dark-elven druid
monsters.description: A powerful dark elf, with mighty nature-controlling enchantments.

monsters.name: Stone troll
monsters.description: He is a giant troll with scabrous black skin.

monsters.name: Black
monsters.description:
The eldritch blood of Yibb-Tstll is know only as "the Black": it is
an amorphous substance, which will suck your life and deliver it to
Yibb-Tstll.

monsters.name: Wereworm
monsters.description:
A huge wormlike shape dripping acid, twisted by evil sorcery into a foul
monster that breeds on death.

monsters.name: Killer red beetle
monsters.description: A giant beetle with poisonous mandibles.

monsters.name: Ghoul
monsters.description: Flesh is falling off in chunks from this decaying abomination.

monsters.name: Undead stargazer
monsters.description:
A stargazer brought back from the dead under control of some unholy
sorcerer.

monsters.name: Killer whale
monsters.description: An almost beautiful, deadly beast.

monsters.name: Giant brown tick
monsters.description: It is moving slowly towards you.

monsters.name: Gold ant
monsters.description:
A giant ant covered in shaggy fur. Its lightning-quick jaws start clapping
excitedly as it spots you, causing quite some noise.

monsters.name: Wolf chieftain
monsters.description:
A great wolf-chieftain whose pack is in the service of the Dark Lord,
and whose howls strike fear into even the boldest heart.

monsters.name: Disenchanter bat
monsters.description: A giant bat which feeds on raw magical energy.

monsters.name: Gnoph-Keh
monsters.description:
A creature with a sharp horn: "the hairy myth-thing of the
Greenland ice, that walked sometimes on two legs, sometimes
on four, and sometimes on six."

monsters.name: Giant grey ant
monsters.description: It is an ant encased in shaggy grey fur.

monsters.name: Khufu, the Mummified King
monsters.description: He is out to have revenge on those who have desecrated his tomb.

monsters.name: Giant fire tick
monsters.description: It is smoking and burning with great heat.

monsters.name: Displacer beast
monsters.description: It is a huge black panther, clubbed tentacles sprouting from its shoulders.

monsters.name: Ulwarth, Son of Ulfang
monsters.description: A short and swarthy Easterling.

monsters.name: Cave ogre
monsters.description: A giant orc-like figure with an awesomely muscled frame.

monsters.name: White wraith
monsters.description: It is a tangible but ghostly form made of white fog.

monsters.name: Angel
monsters.description:
Who knows why you are now facing an angel as an enemy? Is it a punishment
from your own god for your sins, or a test of your mettle, or has this angel
been sent by another god on behalf of someone who wishes to claim the glory
for his own god? Perhaps you will never know: but it is here, and you must
fight it.

monsters.name: Gug
monsters.description:
A hideous, beastly, four-armed unclean giant: "...large as a
barrel... The eyes jutted two inches from each side, shaded by
bony protuberances overgrown of the mouth. That mouth had great
yellow fangs and ran from the top to the tally."

monsters.name: Vampiric ixitxachitl
monsters.description: A devil ray of the depths, with vampiric powers.

monsters.name: Void jumpgate mimic
monsters.description:
A strange creature that disguises itself as a void gate to lure
unsuspecting adventurers within reach of its venomous claws.

monsters.name: Mim, Betrayer of Turin
monsters.description:
The last of his race, Mim is a Petty-Dwarf. Petty-Dwarves are strange
creatures, powerful in sorcery and originating in the East. They have
been hunted nearly to extinction by the High Elves.

monsters.name: Hellblade
monsters.description: A deadly blade of chaos, moving of its own volition.

monsters.name: Killer fire beetle
monsters.description: It is a giant beetle wreathed in flames.

monsters.name: Beast of Nurgle
monsters.description:
It walks on four legs, but mostly resembles a slug-shaped jelly.
It even has two disgusting antennae in its head. Yecch!

monsters.name: Creeping adamantite coins
monsters.description:
It appears to be a pile of coins made of precious adamant, slithering toward
you on lots of tiny legs.

monsters.name: Algroth
monsters.description: A powerful troll form. Venom drips from its needlelike claws.

monsters.name: Flamer of Tzeentch
monsters.description: It looks like an inverted mushroom, with two flexible arms.

monsters.name: Roper
monsters.description:
This creature look like a pillar of rock. However, a closer
inspection reveals a glaring eye and powerful tentacles,
which crush its prey and feed it to the creature's hungry
mouth.

monsters.name: Headless
monsters.description: Headless humanoid abominations created by a magical mutation.

monsters.name: Vibration hound
monsters.description:
A blurry canine form which seems to be moving as fast as the eye can
follow. You can feel the earth resonating beneath your feet.

monsters.name: Nexus hound
monsters.description:
A locus of conflicting points coalesce to form the vague shape of a huge
hound. Or is it just your imagination?

monsters.name: Half-ogre
monsters.description:
A giant, brutish figure, as ugly as an orc, but with some of the
intelligence of his half-human ancestry.

monsters.name: Vampire
monsters.description:
It is a humanoid with an aura of power. You notice a sharp set of front
teeth.

monsters.name: Gorgimaera
monsters.description:
The result of evil experiments, this travesty of nature should never be
alive. It has three heads - goat, dragon and gorgon - all attached to a
lion's body.

monsters.name: Shantak
monsters.description: A scaly bird larger than an elephant, with a horse-like head.

monsters.name: Colbran
monsters.description:
A man-shaped form of living lightning, sparks and shocks crackle all over
this madly capering figure, as it leaps and whirls around and about you.

monsters.name: Shimmering mold
monsters.description: It is a strange growth on the dungeon floor, glowing and crackling with sparks.

monsters.name: Murk dweller
monsters.description:
A gigantic aquatic monster, somewhat resembling a cross between a
lobster and a spider. It is coated in poisonous slime and noxious
parasites. This foul creature hides in the silt of the deep ocean floor,
waiting to trap unsuspecting prey.

monsters.name: Stone giant
monsters.description: It is eighteen feet tall and looking at you.

monsters.name: Spirit naga
monsters.description:
A wraithly snake-like form with the torso of a beautiful woman, it is the
most powerful of its kind.

monsters.name: Corpser
monsters.description:
A creature who lives underground and eats surface dwellers that it catches
with its poisonous tentacle, which is the only part of the creature that
is ever seen. Perhaps it is better not to see the part which remains
underground...

monsters.name: Fiend of Slaanesh
monsters.description:
Slaanesh's pet, a large scorpion-like creature with a human face and
reptile skin.

monsters.name: Stairway to Hell
monsters.description: Often found in graveyards.

monsters.name: 5-headed hydra
monsters.description: A strange reptilian creature with five heads dripping venom.

monsters.name: Black knight
monsters.description:
He is a figure encased in deep black plate armour; he looks at you
menacingly.

monsters.name: Seahorse
monsters.description:
Your mind is filled with admiration as you view this wondrous,
magical seahorse.

monsters.name: Clairvoyant
monsters.description:
He is using his supernatural talents to bring about your
destruction.

monsters.name: Lesser wall monster
monsters.description: A sentient, moving section of wall.

monsters.name: Mage
monsters.description:
A fat mage with glasses. And considerable power, too - as you can
tell from the size of his hat.

monsters.name: Mind flayer
monsters.description:
A humanoid form with a gruesome head, tentacular mouth, and piercing
eyes. Claws reach out for you and you feel a presence invade your mind.

monsters.name: The Ultimate Dungeon Cleaner
monsters.description:
It looks like a huge spiked roller. It was designed to keep this dungeon
clean, and you are the biggest spot of dirt in sight.

monsters.name: Deep one
monsters.description:
"I thought their predominant color was a greyish-green,
though they had white bellies. They were mostly shiny and
slippery, but the ridges of their backs were scaly. Their
forms vaguely suggested the anthropoid, while their heads were
the heads of fish, with prodigious bulging eyes that never
closed. At the sides of their necks were palpitating gills and
their long paws were webbed."

monsters.name: Basilisk
monsters.description:
An evil reptile that preys on unsuspecting travellers. Its eyes stare
deeply at you and your soul starts to wilt!

monsters.name: Ice troll
monsters.description: He is a white troll with powerfully clawed hands.

monsters.name: Beorn, the Shape-Changer
monsters.description:
Beorn is only occasionally seen in human form these days, preferring to
appear in the shape of a giant black bear: he also prefers the company of
beasts to that of humans. He has never taken kindly to strangers, even in
human form - and still less when in bear's shape, as he is now.

monsters.name: Spectator
monsters.description:
A lesser relative of the beholder: a globular body with a large toothy mouth,
a large central eye, and four smaller eyes on stalks protruding from the top
of its body.

monsters.name: Merrow
monsters.description: A great ogre of the sea, it is violent and stupid.

monsters.name: Bat of Gorgoroth
monsters.description:
Fed with horrid meats and grown to enormous size, this slavering creature
seeks livelier prey.

monsters.name: Uldor the Accursed
monsters.description:
An evil and cunning man from the East. Having once sworn allegiance to the
sons of Feanor, it was Uldor's treachery that turned the tide of the Battle
of Unnumbered Tears in Morgoth's favour.

monsters.name: Barney the Dinosaur
monsters.description: The lovable purple reptile is making a guest appearance here.

monsters.name: Purple worm
monsters.description:
It is a massive worm form, many feet in length. Its vast maw drips acid
and poison.

monsters.name: Catoblepas
monsters.description:
A strange ox-like form with a huge head but a thin, weak neck, it looks
like the creation of some deranged alchemist.

monsters.name: Dhole
monsters.description:
A gigantic worm dripping with acid. "...even as he looked, one
reared up several hundred feet and leveled a bleached, viscous end
at him."

monsters.name: Greater mimic
monsters.description:
A strange creature that disguises itself as an object to lure
unsuspecting adventurers within reach of its venomous claws.

monsters.name: Chaos tile
monsters.description: It is a floor tile corrupted by chaos.

monsters.name: Young blue dragon
monsters.description:
It has a form that legends are made of. Its still-tender scales are a
deep blue in hue. Sparks crackle along its length.

monsters.name: Young white dragon
monsters.description:
It has a form that legends are made of. Its still-tender scales are a
frosty white in hue. Icy blasts of cold air come from it as it breathes.

monsters.name: Young green dragon
monsters.description:
It has a form that legends are made of. Its still-tender scales are a
deep green in hue. Foul gas seeps through its scales.

monsters.name: Young bronze dragon
monsters.description:
It has a form that legends are made of. Its still-tender scales are a
rich bronze hue, and its shape masks its true form.

monsters.name: Aklash
monsters.description:
Pale, bald, fat, hairless troll creatures. Ugly beyond description.
Not to mention how bad their breath smells...

monsters.name: Elder stargazer
monsters.description: A stargazer a bit larger than average, covered with barnacles.

monsters.name: Dimensional shambler
monsters.description:
A shabby humanoid with a wrinkled skin. It seems to shift
in and out of existence as you watch.

monsters.name: Ghast
monsters.description:
This vile abomination is a relative of ghouls, and often leads packs
of them. It smells foul, and its bite carries a rotting disease.

monsters.name: Fleshhound of Khorne
monsters.description:
A revolting canine creature, a huge demon hound with a somewhat
reptilian head.

monsters.name: Mithril golem
monsters.description: It is a massive statue of purest mithril. It looks expensive!

monsters.name: Skeleton troll
monsters.description: It is a troll skeleton animated by dark dweomers.

monsters.name: Skeletal tyrannosaur
monsters.description: It is the skeleton of a tyrannosaur, animated by dark dweomers.

monsters.name: Thorondor, Lord of Eagles
monsters.description:
Among the mightiest of birds, Thorondor is the messenger the Valar, and
brings news of Middle-earth to Valinor itself. Nothing that can be seen
from the airs of the world is hidden from him.

monsters.name: Giant blue ant
monsters.description: It is a giant ant that crackles with energy.

monsters.name: Grave wight
monsters.description: It is a ghostly form with eyes that haunt you.

monsters.name: Manticore
monsters.description:
It is a winged lion's body with a human torso and a tail covered in
vicious spikes.

monsters.name: Giant army ant
monsters.description:
An armoured form moving with purpose. Powerful on its own, flee when
hordes of them march.

monsters.name: Killer slicer beetle
monsters.description:
It is a beetle with deadly sharp cutting mandibles and a rock-hard
carapace.

monsters.name: Mountain ogre
monsters.description: The largest breed of ogre, he is awesomely strong and awesomly ugly.

monsters.name: Giant octopus
monsters.description: A cunning and dangerous undersea opponent.

monsters.name: Green dragonrider
monsters.description: A Dragonrider of Pern. Among the weaker breeds, but still dangerous.

monsters.name: Aranea
monsters.description: A red arachnid with legs weaving spells in the air.

monsters.name: Experienced possessor (soul)
monsters.description: It does not look that powerful.

monsters.name: The Sandworm Queen
monsters.description: Queen and Mother of the sandworms, fear her and her prolific children.

monsters.name: Landmine
monsters.description: It was left here to be used against intruders.

monsters.name: Unbeliever
monsters.description: A scarred warrior who moves with strange confidence.

monsters.name: Psychedelic ball
monsters.description: A crackling ball of illusion, zooming about seemingly at random.

monsters.name: Young silver dragon
monsters.description:
It has a form that legends are made of. Its still-tender scales are a
shining silvery gleam, and its shape masks its true form.

monsters.name: Cloud giant
monsters.description: It is a twenty foot tall giant wreathed in clouds.

monsters.name: Gorgon
monsters.description:
A bull-like creature whose skin is made of steel plates. Watch out for
its deadly breath!

monsters.name: Ghost
monsters.description: You don't believe in them.

monsters.name: Death watch beetle
monsters.description: It is a giant beetle that produces a chilling sound.

monsters.name: Young black dragon
monsters.description:
It has a form that legends are made of. Its still-tender scales are a
darkest black hue. Acid drips from its body.

monsters.name: Young gold dragon
monsters.description:
It has a form that legends are made of. Its still-tender scales are a
tarnished gold hue, and light is reflected from its form.

monsters.name: Young red dragon
monsters.description:
It has a form that legends are made of. Its still-tender scales are a
deepest red hue. Heat radiates from its form.

monsters.name: Young dragon turtle
monsters.description:
A dragon-like creature inhabiting lightless reaches of ocean caves. It has
a long neck with a tiny head, and four massive flippers. It has a soft and
flexible shell.

monsters.name: Lokkak, the Ogre Chieftain
monsters.description:
An ogre renowned for acts of surprising cruelty, Lokkak is the leader of a
large band of violent ogres.

monsters.name: Nexus quylthulg
monsters.description: It is a very unstable, strange pulsing mound of flesh.

monsters.name: Ghoulking
monsters.description: Flesh is falling off in chunks from this decaying abomination.

monsters.name: Doombat
monsters.description:
It is a fast moving creature of chaos, a gigantic black bat
surrounded by flickering bright red flames.

monsters.name: Ninja
monsters.description: A humanoid clothed in black who moves with blinding speed.

monsters.name: Memory moss
monsters.description:
A mass of vegetation. You don't remember seeing anything like it
before.

monsters.name: Young multi-hued dragon
monsters.description:
It has a form that legends are made of. Beautiful scales of shimmering
and magical colours cover it.

monsters.name: Shadow drake
monsters.description:
It is a dragon-like form wrapped in shadow. Glowing red eyes shine out in
the dark, and it is surrounded by an aura of unearthly cold that chills
the soul rather than the body.

monsters.name: Bokrug
monsters.description: A lizard-like Great Old One worshipped by the men of Sarnath.

monsters.name: Ivory monk
monsters.description: A monk trained in the most lethal martial arts.

monsters.name: Cave troll
monsters.description: He is a vicious monster, feared for his ferocity.

monsters.name: Anti-paladin
monsters.description: An embodiment of all the cardinal vices, he beholds you scornfully.

monsters.name: Barrow wight
monsters.description: It is a ghostly nightmare of an entity.

monsters.name: Skeleton ettin
monsters.description: It is the animated skeleton of a massive two-headed troll.

monsters.name: Chaos drake
monsters.description:
A dragon twisted by the forces of chaos. It seems first ugly, then fair,
as its form shimmers and changes in front of your eyes.

monsters.name: Law drake
monsters.description:
This dragon is clever and cunning. It laughs at your puny efforts to
disturb it.

monsters.name: Balance drake
monsters.description:
A mighty dragon, the balance drake seeks to maintain the Cosmic Balance,
and despises your feeble efforts to destroy evil.

monsters.name: Ethereal drake
monsters.description:
A dragon of great power with control over light and dark, the
ethereal drake's eyes glare with white hatred from the shadows.

monsters.name: Fasolt the Giant
monsters.description: Big, brawny, powerful and with a greed for gold.

monsters.name: Shade
monsters.description:
A shadowy form clutches at you from the darkness. A powerful undead with
a deadly touch.

monsters.name: Spectre
monsters.description:
A phantasmal shrieking spirit. Its wail drives the intense cold of pure
evil deep within your body.

monsters.name: Fire elemental
monsters.description: It is a towering inferno of flames.

monsters.name: Water elemental
monsters.description: It is a towering tempest of water.

monsters.name: Multi-hued hound
monsters.description: Shimmering in rainbow hues, this hound is beautiful and deadly.

monsters.name: Crystal drake
monsters.description:
