A dragon of strange crystalline form. Light shines through it, dazzling
your eyes with spectrums of colour.

monsters.name: Mystic
monsters.description:
An adept at unarmed combat, the mystic strikes with stunning power. He
can summon help from nature and is able to focus his power to ease any
pain.

monsters.name: Archangel
monsters.description:
A lesser angel protected by an aura of holiness. Its muscular form looks
extremely powerful next to your own frail body.

monsters.name: Half-troll
monsters.description: A huge, ugly, half-human in search of plunder.

monsters.name: Bert the Stone Troll
monsters.description:
Big, brawny, powerful and with a taste for hobbit. He has friends called
Bill and Tom.

monsters.name: Bill the Stone Troll
monsters.description:
Big, brawny, powerful and with a taste for hobbit. He has friends called
Bert and Tom.

monsters.name: Tom the Stone Troll
monsters.description:
Big, brawny, powerful and with a taste for hobbit. He has friends called
Bert and Bill.

monsters.name: Carrion crawler
monsters.description:
A hideous centipede covered in slime and with glowing tentacles around its
head.

monsters.name: Master thief
monsters.description: Cool and confident, fast and lithe; protect your possessions quickly!

monsters.name: Lich
monsters.description: It is a skeletal form dressed in robes. It radiates vastly evil power.

monsters.name: Gas spore
monsters.description:
From a distance, this creature is often mistaken for the
much more dangerous beholder.

monsters.name: Bloodletter of Khorne
monsters.description:
Slender, red-skinned demons twisting in nightmarish shapes.
They are armed with hellblades, which will suck the life from
your body.

monsters.name: Giant grey scorpion
monsters.description: It is a giant grey scorpion. It looks poisonous.

monsters.name: Earth elemental
monsters.description: It is a towering form composed of rock with fists of awesome power.

monsters.name: Air elemental
monsters.description: It is a towering tornado of winds.

monsters.name: Gargoyle
monsters.description: A weird demon creature with a stone-like skin.

monsters.name: Eog golem
monsters.description:
It is a massive deep brown statue, striding towards you with an
all-too-familiar purpose. Your magic surprisingly feels much less
powerful now.

monsters.name: Mature white dragon
monsters.description: A large dragon, scales gleaming bright white.

monsters.name: Mature blue dragon
monsters.description: A large dragon, scales tinted deep blue.

monsters.name: Mature green dragon
monsters.description: A large dragon, scales tinted deep green.

monsters.name: Mature bronze dragon
monsters.description: A large dragon with scales of rich bronze.

monsters.name: Mummified troll
monsters.description:
It is a massive figure clothed in wrappings. You are wary of its massive
fists.

monsters.name: Fire Phantom
monsters.description:
He's back from the grave for vengeance on those who
burnt him. He has no mercy for those in his way.

monsters.name: Saenathra, Daughter of Shelob
monsters.description:
Daughter of Shelob, the legendary Spider-Queen, Saenathra has built her own
empire deep within the shadows of Mirkwood. With legions of ghastly giant
spiders at her command, she has accumulated an untold fortune of treasure.

monsters.name: Ultimate mimic
monsters.description:
A strange creature that disguises itself as an object to lure
unsuspecting adventurers within reach of its venomous claws.

monsters.name: Silent watcher
monsters.description:
A figure carved from stone, with three vulture faces whose eyes glow
with a malevolent light. None escape its vigilance.

monsters.name: Storm giant
monsters.description: It is a twenty-five foot tall giant wreathed in lightning.

monsters.name: Groo, the Wanderer
monsters.description:
He who laughs at Groo's brains will find there is nothing to laugh
about... erm, nobody laughs at Groo and lives.

monsters.name: Water troll
monsters.description: He is a troll that reeks of brackish water and mud.

monsters.name: Invisible stalker
monsters.description: It is impossible to define its form but its violence is legendary.

monsters.name: Malicious leprechaun
monsters.description: This little creature has a fiendish gleam in its eyes.

monsters.name: Little Boy
monsters.description: A shining machine of death and destruction.

monsters.name: Dagashi
monsters.description: A human warrior, moving with lightning speed.

monsters.name: Headless ghost
monsters.description: A phantasmal apparition with no head.

monsters.name: Dread
monsters.description:
It is a form that screams its presence against the eye. Death incarnate,
its hideous black body seems to struggle against reality as the universe
itself struggles to banish it.

monsters.name: Leng spider
monsters.description: Bloated purple spiders with long, bristly legs.

monsters.name: Halfling slinger
monsters.description: A rebel halfling who has rejected the halfling tradition of archery.

monsters.name: Gravity hound
monsters.description:
Unfettered by the usual constraints of gravity, these unnatural creatures
are walking on the walls and even the ceiling! The earth suddenly feels
rather less solid as you see gravity warp all round these monsters.

monsters.name: Acidic cytoplasm
monsters.description: A disgusting animated blob of destruction. Flee its gruesome hunger!

monsters.name: Inertia hound
monsters.description:
Bizarrely, this hound seems to be hardly moving at all, yet it approaches
you with deadly menace. It makes you tired just to look at it.

monsters.name: Impact hound
monsters.description:
A milky shape is visible before you, its canine form strikes you with
an almost physical force. The dungeon floor buckles as if struck by a
powerful blow as it stalks towards you.

monsters.name: Mumak
monsters.description: A massive elephantine form with eyes twisted by madness.

monsters.name: Giant fire ant
monsters.description: A giant ant covered in shaggy fur. Its powerful jaws glow with heat.

monsters.name: Hellhound
monsters.description: It is a giant dog that glows with heat. Flames pour from its nostrils.

monsters.name: The Wight-King of the Barrow-downs
monsters.description:
He has lived in the Barrow-Downs for centuries after his first death at the
hands of the Witch-King of Angmar. A once loyal captain under the
Witch-King's command, he now awaits a time when his undead forces shall
rise again to avenge their deaths.

monsters.name: Incubus
monsters.description:
A daemon with a form of handsome man, he visits you
while asleep and...

monsters.name: Succubus
monsters.description:
A daemon with a form of beautiful woman, she visits you
while asleep and...

monsters.name: Mature silver dragon
monsters.description: A large dragon with scales of radiating silver.

monsters.name: Impact hound
monsters.description:
A milky shape is visible before you, its canine form strikes you with
an almost physical force. The dungeon floor buckles as if struck by a
powerful blow as it stalks towards you.

monsters.name: Healthy blob A
monsters.description: For blob war game.

monsters.name: Mostly healthy blob A
monsters.description: For blob war game.

monsters.name: Wounded blob A
monsters.description: For blob war game.

monsters.name: Badly wounded blob A
monsters.description: For blob war game.

monsters.name: Mortally wounded blob A
monsters.description: For blob war game.

monsters.name: Healthy blob B
monsters.description: For blob war game.

monsters.name: Mostly healthy blob B
monsters.description: For blob war game.

monsters.name: Wounded blob B
monsters.description: For blob war game.

monsters.name: Badly wounded blob B
monsters.description: For blob war game.

monsters.name: Mortally wounded blob B
monsters.description: For blob war game.

monsters.name: Master vampire
monsters.description:
It is a humanoid form dressed in robes. Power emanates from its chilling
frame.

monsters.name: Greater mummy
monsters.description: Once a powerful ruler, now an even more powerful undead menace.

monsters.name: Gauth
monsters.description: Another lesser relative of the beholder, this six-eyed creature feeds on magic.

monsters.name: Smoke elemental
monsters.description: It is a towering blackened form, crackling with heat.

monsters.name: Olog
monsters.description:
It is a massive troll, more intelligent than most of its kind, with needle-
sharp fangs.

monsters.name: Ooze elemental
monsters.description: It is a towering mass of filth, an eyesore of ooze.

monsters.name: Xorn
monsters.description:
A huge creature of the element Earth. Able to merge with its element, it
has four huge arms protruding from its enormous torso.

monsters.name: Mist giant
monsters.description:
"Two eyes, the colour of a thin, yellow wine, were set high in the
thing's body; though it had no separate head. A mouthing, obscene slit,
filled with fangs lay just beneath the eyes. It had no nose or ears...
Four appendages sprang from its upper parts and its lower body
slithered along the ground, unsupported by any limbs... incredibly
disgusting to behold and its amorphous body gave off a stench of death
and decay..."

monsters.name: Phantom
monsters.description:
An unholy creature of darkness, the aura emanating from this evil being
saps your very soul.

monsters.name: Grey wraith
monsters.description:
A tangible but ghostly form, made of grey fog. The air around it feels
deathly cold.

monsters.name: Revenant
monsters.description:
Back from the grave, to wreak vengeance upon the living. A skeletal figure
wearing a black robe, with eyes that burn with undying hatred.

monsters.name: Raal's Tome of Destruction
monsters.description: A sentient arcane tome casting spells with malevolent intent.

monsters.name: Colossus
monsters.description:
An enormous construct resembling a titan made from stone. It strides
purposefully towards you, swinging its slow fists with earth-shattering
power.

monsters.name: Nightblade
monsters.description: A dark elven assassin, so stealthy that he is almost impossible to see.

monsters.name: Trapper
monsters.description:
This creature traps unsuspecting victims
and paralyzes them, to be slowly digested later.

monsters.name: Bodak
monsters.description: It is a humanoid form composed of flames and hatred.

monsters.name: Time bomb
monsters.description: It was left here to be used against intruders.

monsters.name: Mezzodaemon
monsters.description: An ugly demon with insect-like extremities and large bulbous eyes.

monsters.name: Elder thing
monsters.description:
"...some ridged barrel-shaped objects with thin
horizontal arms radiating spoke-like from a central ring and with
vertical knobs or bulbs projecting from the head and base of the
barrel. Each of these knobs was the hub of a system of five long,
flat, triangularly tapering arms arranged around it like the arms
of a starfish."

monsters.name: Necromancer
monsters.description: A gaunt figure, clothed in black robes.

monsters.name: The Greater Hell Magic Mushroom Were-Quylthulg
monsters.description: This unholy abomination will crush you too. Flee while you can!

monsters.name: Lorgan, Chief of the Easterlings
monsters.description:
A mighty warrior from the east, Lorgan hates everything that he cannot
control.

monsters.name: Mature red dragon
monsters.description: A large dragon, scales tinted deep red.

monsters.name: Mature gold dragon
monsters.description: A large dragon with scales of gleaming gold.

monsters.name: Mature black dragon
monsters.description: A large dragon, with scales of deepest black.

monsters.name: Demonologist
monsters.description: A figure twisted by evil standing in robes of deepest crimson.

monsters.name: The Insane Player
monsters.description:
Once a powerful adventurer, this poor fighter has seen a few too many
software bugs in his time. Any shred of lucidity is long gone, but
he still remains dangerous. He wanders aimlessly through the dungeon
randomly striking at foes both real and imagined, all the while screaming
out at the world that caused his condition.

monsters.name: Chaos master
monsters.description: An adept of chaos, feared for his skill of invoking raw Chaos.

monsters.name: Shardstorm
monsters.description:
A howling blast of razor-sharp mountain fragments, kept intact by perilous
magics.

monsters.name: Ice elemental
monsters.description: It is a towering glacier of ice.

monsters.name: Crypt thing
monsters.description: It is a skeletal form dressed in robes. It looks evil and devious...

monsters.name: Chaos butterfly
monsters.description:
With fractal patterns on its wings, it is clearly one of those butterflies
that mathematicians keep talking about - the ones that flap their wings on the
other side of the world to cause storms here. Now's your chance to stop it...

monsters.name: Flying polyp
monsters.description:
"They were only partly material and had the power of aerial motion,
despite the absence of wings... Suggestions of monstrous plasticity
and of temporary lapses of visibility..."

monsters.name: Shan
monsters.description:
"Those huge lidless eyes which stared with hate at me, the jointed
tendrils which seemed to twist from the head in cosmic rhythms,
the ten legs, covered with black shining tentacles and folded into
the pallid underbelly, and the semi-circular ridged wings covered
with triangular scales -- all this cannot convey the soul-ripping
horror of the shape which darted at me. I saw the three mouths
of the thing move moistly, and then it was upon me."

monsters.name: Magma elemental
monsters.description: It is a towering glowing form of molten rock.

monsters.name: Black pudding
monsters.description: A lump of rotting black flesh that slurrrrrrrps across the dungeon floor.

monsters.name: Killer iridescent beetle
monsters.description: It is a giant beetle, whose carapace shimmers with vibrant energies.

monsters.name: Nexus vortex
monsters.description: A maelstrom of potent magical energy.

monsters.name: Plasma vortex
monsters.description: A whirlpool of intense flame, charring the stones at your feet.

monsters.name: Shadow
monsters.description:
A mighty spirit of darkness of vaguely humanoid form. Razor-edged claws
reach out to end your life as it glides towards you, seeking to suck the
energy from your soul to feed its power.

monsters.name: Scrag
monsters.description: A troll of the sea, he reeks of brine.

monsters.name: Chaos spawn
monsters.description: It has two eyestalks and a large central eye. Its gaze can kill.

monsters.name: Will o' the wisp
monsters.description:
A strange ball of glowing light. It disappears and reappears and seems to
draw you to it. You seem somehow compelled to stand still and watch its
strange dancing motion.

monsters.name: Mature multi-hued dragon
monsters.description: A large dragon, scales shimmering many colours.

monsters.name: Sky whale
monsters.description: A vastly intelligent whale-like being from the stars.

monsters.name: Draebor, the Imp
monsters.description: An intensely irritating git of a monster.

monsters.name: Death knight
monsters.description:
It is a humanoid figure dressed in armour of an ancient form. From beneath
its helmet, eyes glow a baleful red and seem to pierce you like lances of
fire.

monsters.name: Castamir the Usurper
monsters.description:
A Black Numenorean who usurped the throne of Gondor, he is treacherous and
evil.

monsters.name: Time vortex
monsters.description: You haven't seen it yet.

monsters.name: Shimmering vortex
monsters.description:
A strange pillar of shining light that hurts your eyes. Its shape changes
constantly as it cuts through the air towards you. It is like a beacon,
waking monsters from their slumber.

monsters.name: Emperor wight
monsters.description:
Your life force is torn from your body as this powerful unearthly being
approaches.

monsters.name: Black wraith
monsters.description:
A figure that seems made of void, its strangely human shape is cloaked in
shadow. It reaches out at you.

monsters.name: Nightgaunt
monsters.description: It is a black, horned humanoid with wings.

monsters.name: Baron of hell
monsters.description: A minor demon lord with a goat's head, tough to kill.

monsters.name: Eldrak
monsters.description:
A massive troll of huge strength. Eldraks are extremely stupid and extremely
violent.

monsters.name: Giganto, the Gargantuan
monsters.description:
A gargantuan mutant whale, who has grown legs that enable it to walk
on dry land as well.

monsters.name: Mature dragon turtle
monsters.description: A large dragon turtle, covered with a tough white shell.

monsters.name: Erinyes
monsters.description:
It is a lesser demon of female form; however, she takes little time to
show her true colours.

monsters.name: Snake of Yig
monsters.description: It is a giant snake that drips with poison.

monsters.name: Cherub
monsters.description:
It is an angel moving very quickly, wielding a holy war hammer and casting
a volley of powerful spells in your direction.

monsters.name: Time elemental
monsters.description: You have not seen it yet.

monsters.name: Monastic lich
monsters.description:
A skeletal form wrapped in priestly robes. Before its un-death, it
was a monk in an evil order.

monsters.name: Nether wraith
monsters.description:
A form that hurts the eye, death permeates the air around it. As it nears
you, a coldness saps your soul.

monsters.name: 7-headed hydra
monsters.description: A strange reptilian creature with seven heads dripping venom.

monsters.name: Kavlax the Many-Headed
monsters.description:
A large dragon with a selection of heads, all shouting and arguing as they
look for prey, but each with its own deadly breath weapon.

monsters.name: Chthonian
monsters.description:
"Flowing tentacles and a pulpy gray-black elongated sack of a body...
no distinguishing features at all other than the reaching, groping
tentacles. Or was there -- yes! -- a lump in the upper body of
the thing... a container of sorts for the brain, ganglia, or
whichever diseased organ governed this horror's loathsome life!"

monsters.name: Ettin
monsters.description:
A massive two-headed troll, larger and stronger than many men together.
Fortunately, ettins are solitary creatures. They are also living proof that
two heads are not necessarily more intelligent than one...

monsters.name: Night mare
monsters.description:
A fearsome skeletal horse with glowing eyes that watch you with little
more than a hatred of all that lives. Its flying hooves do not touch the
ground.

monsters.name: Swamp serpent
monsters.description: A huge snake-like reptile with green scales that inhabits swamps.

monsters.name: Cyclops
monsters.description: A gigantic humanoid with but one eye.

monsters.name: Oriental vampire
monsters.description: The oriental vampire can transform into a mist at will.

monsters.name: Mother Hydra
monsters.description:
The queen of the deep ones. "Vast, Polyphemus-like, and loathsome, it
darted like a stupendous monster of nightmares..."

monsters.name: Ancient blue dragon
monsters.description: A huge draconic form. Lightning crackles along its length.

monsters.name: Ancient bronze dragon
monsters.description: A huge draconic form enveloped in a cascade of colour.

monsters.name: Beholder
monsters.description:
A vile creature with one huge central eye, twelve smaller eyes on stalks, and
a huge mouth filled with sharp teeth.

monsters.name: Ancient white dragon
monsters.description: A huge draconic form. Frost covers it from head to tail.

monsters.name: Ancient green dragon
monsters.description: A huge draconic form enveloped in clouds of poisonous vapour.

monsters.name: Weird fume
monsters.description: A swirling spiral of mist, constantly changing its appearance.

monsters.name: Spawn of Ubbo-Sathla
monsters.description: Weird, jelly like creatures. No two look the same.

monsters.name: Fat Man
monsters.description: A shining machine of death and destruction.

monsters.name: Shadowfax, steed of Gandalf
monsters.description:
Shadowfax is the chief of the "Mearas", the greatest of all horses that are
bred in the fields of Rohan. Although the Mearas should technically be only
ridden by the royal family of Rohan, only Gandalf the Wizard has ever
succeeded in taming Shadowfax: and even then, Shadowfax will not be subjected
to a bridle or saddle, but must be ridden bareback.

monsters.name: Spirit troll
monsters.description: A weird ghostly troll-like being from the ethereal plane.

monsters.name: War troll
monsters.description: A massive troll, equipped with a scimitar and heavy armour.

monsters.name: Disenchanter worm mass
monsters.description:
It is a strange mass of squirming worms. Magical energy crackles
around its disgusting form.

monsters.name: 9-headed hydra
monsters.description: A strange reptilian creature with nine smouldering heads.

monsters.name: Enchantress
monsters.description:
This elusive female spellcaster has a special affinity for dragons, whom
she rarely fights without.

monsters.name: Sorcerer
monsters.description:
A human figure in robes, he moves with magically improved speed, and his
hands are ablur with spell casting.

monsters.name: Xaren
monsters.description: It is a tougher relative of the Xorn. Its hide glitters with metal ores.

monsters.name: Giant roc
monsters.description:
A vast legendary bird, its iron talons rake the most impenetrable of
surfaces and its screech echoes through the many winding dungeon corridors.

monsters.name: Minotaur
monsters.description: It is a cross between a human and a bull.

monsters.name: Medusa, the Gorgon
monsters.description:
One of the original three ugly sisters. Her face could sink a thousand
ships. Her scales rattle as she slithers towards you, venom dripping from
her ghastly mouth.

monsters.name: Wyrd sister
monsters.description:
This old crone is rumoured to be a witch of chaos... but you don't
really believe in witches, do you?

monsters.name: Vrock
monsters.description: It is a demon with a long neck and raking claws.

monsters.name: Death quasit
monsters.description:
It is a demon of small stature, but its armoured frame moves with
lightning speed and its powers make it a tornado of death and destruction.

monsters.name: Patriarch
monsters.description:
An evil priest, dressed all in black. Deadly spells hit you at an
alarming rate as his black spiked mace rains down blow after blow on your
pitiful frame.

monsters.name: Master mindcrafter
monsters.description:
A mindcrafter of the highest order. Powerful and evil, and a dangerous
enemy: a master of mind over matter, of his own mind, and of the minds of
others, who slavishly follow him into battle when he calls them.

monsters.name: Eye of the deep
monsters.description:
A beholder that inhabits the depths of the sea, sleeping and pondering
alien thoughts for centuries. Occasionally, it will float to the
surface to wreck the lives of surface dwellers.

monsters.name: Jaws
monsters.description: The biggest white shark who has ever lived, it is hunting for you now!

monsters.name: Water demon
monsters.description:
A hideous scaled demon, it is a sleek form with many fins but no visible
arms or legs. It has a toothed gaping maw, reminiscent of a caricature
of a shark's jaws.

monsters.name: Mature spirit
monsters.description: A helpful spirit from beyond the grave.

monsters.name: High-elven ranger
monsters.description: An elf cloaked in green wielding a longbow.

monsters.name: Uvatha the Horseman
monsters.description:
A tall black Ringwraith, he is a master of horsemanship. He longs
to taste your blood.

monsters.name: Blue dragonrider
monsters.description: A Dragonrider of Pern. Among the weaker breeds, but still dangerous.

monsters.name: Elder aranea
monsters.description:
A vast, bloated arachnid, master of its brood: among the more terrible of
Ungoliant's descendants, this is a monster such as those who haunted the dread
valley of Nan Dungortheb long ago.

monsters.name: The Minotaur of the Labyrinth
monsters.description: It is a cross between a human and a bull.

monsters.name: Emperor Mimic
monsters.description:
A strange creature that disguises itself as an object to lure
unsuspecting adventurers within reach of its venomous claws.

monsters.name: Swordsmaster
monsters.description: A warrior of considerable skill.

monsters.name: The Kung-Fu Yeek from Hell
monsters.description: A small humanoid that radiates hellish power.

monsters.name: Giant squid
monsters.description:
Besides being capable of dragging whole ships underwater,
this creature can also harm you with ranged attacks.

monsters.name: Rogrog the Black Troll
monsters.description:
A massive and cruel troll of great power, drool slides caustically down
his muscular frame. Despite his bulk, he strikes with stunning speed.

monsters.name: Ancient black dragon
monsters.description: A huge draconic form. Pools of acid melt the floor around it.

monsters.name: Ranger chieftain
monsters.description:
A chieftain among the Rangers. His understanding of nature gives him
powerful elemental spells to use against you, in addition to his skills
as an archer and a warrior. Furthermore, he is a master of camouflage, so
you will need magically enhanced seeing to spot him.

monsters.name: Ancient red dragon
monsters.description:
A huge draconic form. Wisps of smoke steam from its nostrils and the
extreme heat surrounding it makes you gasp for breath.

monsters.name: Ancient gold dragon
monsters.description:
A huge draconic form wreathed in a nimbus of light. Its roar stuns and
deafens you.

monsters.name: Strygalldwir
monsters.description:
"it was well over six feet in height, with great branches of antlers
growing out of its forehead. Nude, its flesh was a uniform ash-gray
in color. It appeared to be sexless, and it had gray, leathery wings
extending far out behind it."

monsters.name: Giant headless
monsters.description: Giant headless humanoid abominations created by a magical mutation.

monsters.name: Judge Fire
monsters.description:
One of the Dark Judges, he has come to punish your crime of living.
He looks like a skeleton enveloped in flames.

monsters.name: Ubbo-Sathla, the Unbegotten Source
monsters.description:
"There, in the gray beginning of Earth, the formless mass that was
Ubbo-Sathla reposed amid the slime and the vapors. Headless,
without organs or members..."

monsters.name: Judge Mortis
monsters.description:
Another Dark Judge, he is a rotting humanoid with a cow's skull as
his head.

monsters.name: Dark-elven sorcerer
monsters.description:
A dark elven figure, dressed in deepest black. Power seems to crackle
from his slender frame.

monsters.name: Master lich
monsters.description:
A skeletal form wrapped in robes. Powerful magic crackles along its
bony fingers.

monsters.name: Byakhee
monsters.description:
"There flapped rhythmically a horde of tame, trained, hybrid
winged things... not altogether crows, nor moles, nor buzzards,
nor ants, nor decomposed human beings, but something I cannot
and must not recall."

monsters.name: Formless spawn of Tsathoggua
monsters.description:
"...living things that oozed along stone channels...
But they were not toads like Tsathoggua himself. Far worse --
they were amorphous lumps of viscous black slime that took
temporary shapes for various purposes."

monsters.name: Ancient dragon turtle
monsters.description: A huge dragon turtle. You can see many barnacles covering its body.

monsters.name: Gorlim, Betrayer of Barahir
monsters.description:
This sad creature - once a mighty warrior - betrayed his former friends to
Morgoth's army in return for, he thought, safety for himself and his wife.
And so he fell under Morgoth's power and became little more than a mindless
servant of evil, even though the other side of his "bargain" was not kept.

monsters.name: Hezrou
monsters.description: It is a demon of lizard form with cruel-looking jaws.

monsters.name: Glaryssa, Succubus Queen
monsters.description: Drop dead gorgeous - literally.

monsters.name: Servitor of the outer gods
monsters.description:
"Toad-like creatures which seemed constantly to be changing shape and
appearance, and from whom emanated, by some means I could not distinguish,
a ghostly ululation, a piping." August Derleth - "The Lurker at The
Threshold".

monsters.name: Ancient silver dragon
monsters.description:
A huge draconic form wreathed in a radiance of silver. The emanating cold air
makes it unusually hard for you to move.

monsters.name: Scylla
monsters.description:
A many-headed sea-monster, this foul creature preys on all those who
escape the clutches of Charybdis.

monsters.name: Vampire lord
monsters.description: A foul wind chills your bones as this ghastly figure approaches.

monsters.name: Hunting horror
monsters.description:
"And in the air there were great viperine creatures,
which had curiously distorted heads, and grotesquely great
clawed appendages, supporting themselves with ease by the aid
of black rubbery wings of singularly monstrous dimensions."

monsters.name: Iron lich
monsters.description:
It is a huge, twisted grey skull floating through the air. Its cold eyes
burn with hatred towards all who live.

monsters.name: Dread
monsters.description:
It is a form that screams its presence against the eye. Death incarnate,
its hideous black body seems to struggle against reality as the universe
itself struggles to banish it.

monsters.name: Greater basilisk
monsters.description: A large basilisk, whose shape resembles that of a great wyrm.

monsters.name: Charybdis
monsters.description:
A monstrous dweller of the depths; its hungry maw has been the doom
of innumerable sailors!

monsters.name: Eilinel the Entrapped
monsters.description:
In life, she was the wife of Gorlim. In death, her shade was
entrapped by Morgoth and used to trick her husband into betraying
Barahir. Now she is totally entrapped by Morgoth's power, and uses
her magic to do his bidding.

monsters.name: Biclops
monsters.description:
Oh, no! Aaargh! It is the most unnatural, most disgusting
creature imaginable: a two-eyed cyclops! This perversion
of nature must be exterminated!

monsters.name: Vargo, Tyrant of Fire
monsters.description: A towering fire elemental, Vargo burns everything beyond recognition.

monsters.name: Waldern, King of Water
monsters.description:
A towering water elemental, Waldern is master of all things liquid.
Wave after wave drowns your frail body.

monsters.name: Zephyr lord
monsters.description: An undead master of the vicious Zephyr hounds.

monsters.name: Juggernaut of Khorne
monsters.description:
A great, vicious beast whose flesh is made of steel and whose
blood is fire. It charges at you ignoring everything else.

monsters.name: Judge Fear
monsters.description: A Dark Judge, reputedly so frightening that his gaze can kill.

monsters.name: Ancient multi-hued dragon
monsters.description:
A huge draconic form. Many colours ripple down its massive frame. Few
live to see another.

monsters.name: Dark young of Shub-Niggurath
monsters.description:
"Something black in the road, something that wasn't a tree.
Something big and black and ropy, just squatting there, waiting,
with ropy arms squirming and reaching... It came crawling up the
hillside... and it was the black thing of my dreams... that black,
ropy, slimy jelly tree-thing out of the woods. It crawled up and it
flowed up on its hoofs and mouths and snaky arms."

monsters.name: Colour out of space
monsters.description:
"The shaft of phosphorescence from the well... was no longer shining
out, it was pouring out; and as the shapeless stream of unplaceable
colour left the well it seemed to flow directly into the sky."

monsters.name: Quaker, Master of Earth
monsters.description:
A towering stone elemental stands before you. The walls and ceiling are
reduced to rubble as Quaker advances.

monsters.name: Judge Death
monsters.description: The most powerful Dark Judge, whose touch means death.

monsters.name: Ariel, Queen of Air
monsters.description:
A towering air elemental, Ariel the sorceress avoids your blows
with her extreme speed.

monsters.name: Adunaphel the Quiet
monsters.description:
A sorceress in life, Adunaphel quickly fell under Sauron's sway and the
power of the rings.

monsters.name: Glabrezu
monsters.description: It is a demon with arms and pincers, its form a true mockery of life.

monsters.name: Water hound
monsters.description:
The sound of a hundred waterfalls rushes through your ears as
a huge wave of water, vaguely hound-shaped, rushes towards you.

monsters.name: Malekith the Accursed
monsters.description:
One of the oldest and most powerful dark elves, Malekith is a master
sorcerer devoted to evil. The left side of his face is pale, the other
one is dark. His hair is long and white.

monsters.name: Death leprechaun
monsters.description:
Nasty undead little creatures. They are chanting the name of the
sinister wizard who created them: 'Bruce! Bruce..!'

monsters.name: Chaugnar Faugn, Horror from the Hills
monsters.description:
"The ears were webbed and tentacled, the trunk terminated in
a huge flaring disk at least a foot in diameter... Its forelimbs
were bent stiffly at the elbow, and its hands... rested palms
upward on its lap."

monsters.name: Lloigor
monsters.description:
"Invisible ones from the stars... They sometimes took forms...
but existed as vortices of power in their natural state."

monsters.name: Utgard-Loke
monsters.description: A frost giant chieftain, unusually smart for a giant.

monsters.name: Quachil Uttaus, Treader of the Dust
monsters.description:
"It was a figure no larger than a young child, but severe and
shriveled as some millenial mummy. Its hairless head, its
unfeatured face, borne on a neck of skeleton thinness, were
lined with a thousand reticulated wrinkles. The body was like
that of some monstrous, withered abortion that had never drawn
breath. The pipelike arms, ending in bony claws, were outhrust as if
enclosed in a posture of an eternal dreadful grasping."

monsters.name: Shoggoth
monsters.description:
"The nightmare, plastic column of fetid, black iridescence oozed
tightly onward... A shapeless congerie of protoplasmic bubbles,
faintly self-luminous and with myriads of temporary eyes forming
and unforming as pustules of greenish light all over the
tunnel-filling front that bore down upon us, crushing the frantic
penguins and slithering over glistening floor that it and its
kind had swept so evilly free of all litter. Still came that eldritch
mocking cry -- 'Tekeli-li! Tekeli-li!'"

monsters.name: 11-headed hydra
monsters.description: A strange reptilian hybrid with eleven smouldering heads.

monsters.name: Dreadmaster
monsters.description:
It is an unlife of power almost unequalled. An affront to existence, its
very touch abuses and disrupts the flow of life, and its unearthly limbs,
of purest black, crush rock and flesh with ease.

monsters.name: Drolem
monsters.description:
A constructed dragon, the drolem has massive strength. Powerful spells
weaved during its creation make it a fearsome adversary. Its eyes show
little intelligence, but it has been instructed to destroy all it meets.

monsters.name: Knight Templar
monsters.description:
It seems that the more devout the person, the more likely they are to cross
the boundary between piety and sanctimoniousness. And such is the case with
the Order of the Knights Templar; they are among the most pious and
powerful of the religious knightly orders, but noted for their intolerance.
Thus it is Morgoth's will that is unwittingly done, as the forces of good
are set against each other.

monsters.name: Greater wall monster
monsters.description: A sentient, moving section of wall.

monsters.name: Ulfang the Black
monsters.description:
A short and swarthy Easterling dressed in black. He and his three sons
once openly swore allegiance to the High Elves, but were secretly in the
pay of Morgoth.

monsters.name: Vermicious Knid
monsters.description:
An amorphous shape that looks like wet grey clay with two pale eyes.
It is totally silent as it oozes towards you.

monsters.name: Dragon of Bad Luck
monsters.description:
A huge and very powerful dragon. Great steaming pools of acid drip from
its form onto the ground. You shudder when you see the acid eating away
the very stones of the dungeon - what could it do to you?

monsters.name: Bad luck bat from hell
monsters.description:
A slate and insanely speedy bat of large size, conjured from great
malevolence. Acid drips off its claws while this nightmare shoots
straight at you like lightning.

monsters.name: Berserker
monsters.description:
Even the strongest of normal human warriors fears the Berserker - the one who
can drive himself into such a terrible battle-frenzy that he can survive blows
which should kill him, and still apparently feel no pain. He tramples weaker
creatures underfoot in his eagerness to get to his real enemy, and his
battle-cry strikes terror into his foes.

monsters.name: The Watcher in the Water
monsters.description:
A vile creature which seems to consist mostly of tentacles, it seeks to
drag people to their doom in the water. Few have ever escaped its grasp.

monsters.name: Seraph
monsters.description:
It is an angel, fast and strong. You are stunned by its extreme holiness
and try to resist all desires to obey it.

monsters.name: Rotting quylthulg
monsters.description: It is a pulsing flesh mound that reeks of death and putrefaction.

monsters.name: Death drake
monsters.description:
It is a dragon-like form wrapped in darkness. You cannot make out its
true form but you sense its evil.

monsters.name: Great crystal drake
monsters.description:
A huge crystalline dragon. Its claws could cut you to shreds and its
teeth are razor sharp. Strange colours ripple through it as it moves in
the light.

monsters.name: Undead beholder
monsters.description:
A beholder which has cheated death. Black nether storms rage around the
bloodshot pupil of its central giant eye, and light seems to bend as it
sucks its power from the very air around it. Your soul chills as it drains
your vitality for its evil enchantments.

monsters.name: Ethereal dragon
monsters.description:
A huge dragon emanating from the ethereal plane, this terrible dragon is
a master of light and dark. Its form disappears from sight as it cloaks
itself in unearthly shadows.

monsters.name: Warrior of the Dawn
monsters.description:
Fierce, barbaric warriors, armed with great spiked clubs, and surrounded
in an aura of scarlet. Whenever one of them is slain, another appears
out of nowhere to take his place.

monsters.name: Lesser black reaver
monsters.description: A humanoid form, black as night, advancing steadily and unstoppably.

monsters.name: Zoth-Ommog
monsters.description:
"A body shaped like a road-based, truncated cone. A flat, blunt,
wedge-shaped, vaguely reptilian head surmounts this conical torso,
and the head is almost entirely hidden behind swirling tresses.
This hair, or beard and mane, consists of thickly carved and
coiling ropes, like serpents or worms... Through this repulsive
Medusa-mane of ropy tendrils, two fierce, serpent-like eyes
glare in a horrible intermingling of cold, inhuman mockery and
what I can only describe as gloating menace."

monsters.name: The Stormbringer
monsters.description:
The mightiest of hellblades, a black runesword which thirsts for
your soul.

monsters.name: Demonic quylthulg
monsters.description:
A pile of pulsing flesh that glows with an inner hellish fire. The world
itself seems to cry out against it.

monsters.name: Draconic quylthulg
monsters.description:
It looks like it was once a dragon corpse, now deeply infected with
magical bacteria that make it pulse in a foul and degrading way.

monsters.name: Akhorahil the Blind
monsters.description:
A mighty sorcerer king, Akhorahil was blind in life. With powerful
enchantments, he created jewelled eyes that enabled him to see better than
any ordinary man ever could.

monsters.name: Nalfeshnee
monsters.description:
It is a large demon with the head of a giant boar. Flames run up and down
its length.

monsters.name: Avatar of Nyarlathotep
monsters.description:
The Crawling Chaos with a thousand forms. Nyarlathotep is amused at your
puny attempts to kill him, and will keep coming back for another go
until he gets bored with the game.

monsters.name: Golgarach, the Living Rock
monsters.description:
Deep in the heart of the earth, even the rock itself is sentient
and has learned to despise intruders.

monsters.name: Scatha the Worm
monsters.description:
An ancient and wise Dragon. Scatha has grown clever over the long years.
His scales are covered with frost, and his breath sends a shower of ice
into the air.

monsters.name: Grand master thief
monsters.description:
A class of its own: you are already too late to protect your possessions -
and he seems to have studied magic too, and is a master of setting traps.

monsters.name: Leprechaun fanatic
monsters.description:
These leprechauns are not afraid to die for their cause. They are
carrying explosives and making terrorist strikes...

monsters.name: Spectral tyrannosaur
monsters.description:
A deadly undead horror which looks like a skeletal tyrannosaur
surrounded by a sickly green glow.

monsters.name: Yibb-Tstll, the Patient One
monsters.description:
"There, about the pulsating body of the Ancient One, hugely
winged reptilian creatures without faces cluttered and clutched
at a multitude of blackly writhing, pendulous breasts! Its eyes
moved quickly, independently -- sliding with vile viscosity over
the whole rotten surface of Yib-Tstll's pulpy, glistening head!"

monsters.name: Ghatanothoa
monsters.description:
The chief among the creatures known as Lloigor. Ghatanothoa, unlike most of
his kind, has assumed a shape, and one which is too horrible to describe:
"Nothing I could say could even adumbrate the loathsome, unholy, non-human,
extra-galactic horror and hatefulness and unutterable evil of that forbidden
spawn of black chaos, and illimitable night."

monsters.name: Ent
monsters.description:
A tree-herd: a sentient, moving tree. Its wrath is fearsome, and it could
split stones and even the very rock of Isengard with its roots.

monsters.name: Itangast the Fire Drake
monsters.description:
A mighty ancient dragon, Itangast's form scorches your flesh. Wisps of
smoke curl up from his nostrils as he regards you with disdain.

monsters.name: Death mold
monsters.description:
It is the epitome of all that is evil, in a mold. Its lifeless form draws
power from sucking the souls of those that approach it, a nimbus of pure
evil surrounds it. Luckily for you, it can't move...

monsters.name: Charon, Boatman of the Styx
monsters.description:
The ferryman across the river Styx to the land of the dead.
He wishes to receive payment for your entry.

monsters.name: Quickbeam, the Ent
monsters.description:
Unusually hasty, for an ent. Quickbeam hates evil creatures, and orcs in
particular, since the destruction of his beloved rowan-trees to feed the
fires of Orthanc.

monsters.name: Marilith
monsters.description: She is a demon of female form with many arms, each bearing deadly weapons.

monsters.name: Cult leader
monsters.description:
An evil priest, dressed all in black and devoted to one of the netherworld
demons that call themselves "the outer gods".

monsters.name: Mountain serpent
monsters.description:
A huge snake-like reptile with red and brown scales that inhabits
mountain regions.

monsters.name: Winged horror
monsters.description:
A terrifying sight: a winged creature greater than any bird you have ever
seen, and with no feathers on its horrid black leathery wings. Descended
from a creature of an older world perhaps, bred by Sauron to be a winged
steed for his Ringwraiths.

monsters.name: Fafner the Dragon
monsters.description:
The mighty dragon of myth, Fafner was a giant who slew his
brother to win a treasure hoard, and then transformed himself
into a dragon, greedily watching over his gold.

monsters.name: Ren the Unclean
monsters.description:
Ren was an insane eastern king who believed himself to be the son of a
volcano god. At an early age his sanity was destroyed by a plague that
wiped out his family, and he never recovered.

monsters.name: Fallen angel
monsters.description: An angelic being, who was mighty once, but dared defy its Creator.

monsters.name: Eol, the Dark-Elf
monsters.description:
A lord of the Teleri, Eol is a mighty metalsmith, the first
one to ever forge weapons of meteorite iron. His dark
countenance glares at you in disdain.

monsters.name: Behemoth
monsters.description: A great water-beast, with an almost unpenetrable skin.

monsters.name: Garm, Guardian of Hel
monsters.description:
Garm is a gigantic hound, whose job is to guard that none escapes
the tortures of Hel, the place of punishment for the wicked
and cowardly dead.

monsters.name: Lesser balrog
monsters.description: It is a massive humanoid demon wreathed in flames.

monsters.name: Lesser titan
monsters.description:
It is a humanoid figure thirty feet tall that gives off an aura of power
and hate.

monsters.name: Goat of Mendes
monsters.description:
It is a demonic creature from the lowest hell, vaguely resembling a
large black he-goat.

monsters.name: Maulotaur
monsters.description:
It is a belligerent minotaur with a destructive magical arsenal, armed
with a hammer.

monsters.name: Bloodthirster
monsters.description:
Khorne's mightiest servant, a winged hound-demon walking on
two paws and wielding a mighty axe and a whip in the other
two. Intelligent, bloodthirsty eyes leer at you from inside
the blood-soaked demon armour.

monsters.name: Rocket mine
monsters.description: It was left here to be used against intruders.

monsters.name: The Balrog of Moria
monsters.description:
A huge Balrog surrounded by raging pillars of fire, this is indeed a
terrible opponent. Wielding a great whip of fire and a blazing sword, his
fury blisters your skin and melts your flesh!

monsters.name: Moby Dick, the White Whale
monsters.description:
The mightiest whale of the seas, he has sunk many ships in his time. With
a mere flick of his tail he can create a mighty whirlpool, to the ruin
of all who would travel the ocean.

monsters.name: Brown dragonrider
monsters.description: A Dragonrider of Pern. Beware its flame.

monsters.name: Thread
monsters.description:
A kind of carnivorous giant mycorrhiza: Originally from the far system
of Rukbat in which orbits the planet Pern, home of the Dragonriders.

monsters.name: Master mystic
monsters.description:
A lord of all that is natural, skilled in the mystic ways. He is a master
of martial arts and is at one with nature, able to summon help from the
wild if need be.

monsters.name: The White Balrog
monsters.description:
It is a massive humanoid demon wreathed in frost, wielding a cruel looking
pike in its hands.

monsters.name: Gorm
monsters.description:
A large reptile in black scales, tainted with corruption.
It seems impossible to impede it and its sight chills you to the bone.

monsters.name: Target dummy
monsters.description:
This thing seems to take infinite punishment just fine,
assisting you without complaining in assessing your combat prowess.

monsters.name: Snow-covered target dummy
monsters.description:
This thing seems to take infinite punishment just fine,
assisting you without complaining in assessing your combat prowess.

monsters.name: Armoured target dummy
monsters.description:
This thing seems to take infinite punishment just fine,
assisting you without complaining in assessing your combat prowess.

monsters.name: Snow-covered armoured target dummy
monsters.description:
This thing seems to take infinite punishment just fine,
assisting you without complaining in assessing your combat prowess.

monsters.name: Nycadaemon
monsters.description:
A loathsome, sturdy, winged, horned demon, with talons that could tear
a stone wall down.

monsters.name: Nether hound
monsters.description:
You feel a soul-tearing chill upon viewing this beast, a ghostly form of
darkness in the shape of a large dog.

monsters.name: Time hound
monsters.description:
You get a terrible sense of deja vu, or is it a premonition? All at once
you see a little puppy and a toothless old dog. Perhaps you should give
up and go to bed.

monsters.name: Plasma hound
monsters.description:
The very air warps as pure elemental energy stalks towards you in the
shape of a giant hound. Your hair stands on end and your palms itch as
you sense trouble.

monsters.name: Ulik the Troll
monsters.description:
Ulik is the strongest troll who has ever lived. He could challenge
the immortals and pound them to dust with his great strength.

monsters.name: Harowen the Black Hand
monsters.description:
He is a master of disguise, an expert of stealth, a genius at traps, and
moves with blinding speed. Check your pockets!

monsters.name: Hell knight
monsters.description:
It is a humanoid form dressed in armour of ancient style. From beneath
its helmet, eyes glow with hellfire.

monsters.name: Bull Gates
monsters.description: He may not code worth a dime, but he certainly knows how to make money.

monsters.name: Santa Claus
monsters.description:
Why would anybody want to kill Santa Claus? To get all the presents,
of course!

monsters.name: Fastitocalon
monsters.description: A huge aquatic dragon-turtle, its shell is as large as a small island.

monsters.name: Fangorn the Treebeard, Lord of the Ents
monsters.description:
The first being to awoke on Arda, apart from the Valar themselves. He is the
first, oldest, greatest and most respected of all the Ents: and though he is
slow to anger, he is a terrible foe when roused.

monsters.name: Ji Indur Dawndeath
monsters.description:
This Ringwraith was a weak-minded sorcerer-king who fell easily under
Sauron's power.

monsters.name: The Glass Golem
monsters.description:
One of the last creations of the petty dwarves of Ludarin, its existence
explains their destruction. A creation of finest glass, the body of this
creature bends and amplifies light in a way that makes you unsure of its
position. You feel somewhat dizzy as the radiant light reflects off the
walls, the ceiling and your gear.

monsters.name: Firebird
monsters.description:
A large glowing eagle bathed in flames. The searing heat chars your
skin and melts your armour.

monsters.name: Storm of Unmagic
monsters.description:
Howling through the disintegrating dungeon, this awesome whirlpool of Unmagic
rips the enchantments from everything it touches.

monsters.name: Eihort, the Thing in the Labyrinth
monsters.description:
"Then came pale movement in the well, and something clambered up from the
dark, a bloated blanched oval supported on myriad fleshless legs. Eyes
formed in the gelatinous oval and stared at him."

monsters.name: The King in Yellow
monsters.description:
The King in Yellow is an Avatar of Hastur: "He has no face, and is twice
as tall as a man. He wears pointed shoes under his tattered, fantastically
colored robes, and a streamer of silk appears to fall from the pointed tip
of his hood. At times he appears to be winged; at others, haloed."

monsters.name: Great unclean one
monsters.description:
This disgusting demon resembles a shambling pile of rotting green flesh,
with dozens of mouths drooling and leaving a trail of foul-smelling goo
behind. Nurgle must be proud of himself to have created this atrocity!

monsters.name: Chaos vortex
monsters.description: Void, nothingness, spinning destructively.

monsters.name: Old sorcerer
monsters.description:
A human figure in robes, he moves with magically improved speed, and his
hands are ablur with spell casting. You stagger at the mighty sound of his
spells as they echo hollowly through the dungeon.

monsters.name: Lesser kraken
monsters.description:
An enormously fearsome and powerful inhabitant of the depths. It
resembles a gargantuan octopus and its evil is almost tangible.

monsters.name: Demilich
monsters.description: A lich who is partially immaterial, on its way to a new, ethereal form.

monsters.name: The Phoenix
monsters.description:
A massive glowing eagle bathed in flames. The searing heat chars your
skin and melts your armour.

monsters.name: Lord of Change
monsters.description:
The most powerful of Tzeentch's servitors. This demon looks like
a huge bird-creature, with the head of a predatory bird and
fantastically multi-coloured wings.

monsters.name: Aether vortex
monsters.description: An awesome vortex of pure magic, power radiates from its frame.

monsters.name: Elder vampire
monsters.description:
A terrible robed undead figure, this creature has existed in its
unlife for many centuries by stealing the life of others. It can
summon the very shades of its victims from beyond the grave to
come enslaved to its aid.

monsters.name: Shelob, Spider of Darkness
monsters.description:
Shelob is an enormous bloated spider, the last daughter of Ungoliant the
Unlight. Her poison is legendary, as is her ego. She normally guards the
pass through Cirith Ungol, but occasionally goes out foraging for food to
feed her voracious appetite.

monsters.name: Archon
monsters.description:
Never a more heavenly being have you seen. The very holiness of its
presence makes you deeply respect it. Few creatures can match the powers
of an Archon; fewer still live to tell the tale after attacking one.

monsters.name: Dracolich
monsters.description:
The skeletal form of a once-great dragon, enchanted by magic most
perilous. Its animated form strikes with speed and drains life from its
prey to satisfy its hunger.

monsters.name: Dracolisk
monsters.description:
A mixture of dragon and basilisk, the dracolisk stares at you with deep
piercing eyes, its evil breath burning the ground where it stands.

monsters.name: Barbazu
monsters.description:
A foul, humanoid creature with a long tail, clawed hands and feet,
and a disgusting, wiry, snaky beard. They are the elite shock troops
of the hells, capable of a terrifying berserk fury.

monsters.name: Ethereal hound
monsters.description:
A pale green hound. Pulsing red lines and strange fluorescent light
hints at internal organs best left to the imagination.

monsters.name: Nidhogg, the Hel-Drake
monsters.description:
In the bowels of Hel, the dread Nidhogg, a dragon blacker than the
night, feasts on the essences of the dead.

monsters.name: The Lernaean Hydra
monsters.description:
A massive legendary hydra. It has twelve powerful heads. Its many eyes
stare at you as clouds of smoke and poisonous vapour rise from its
seething form. It grows new heads as fast as you chop them off.

monsters.name: Hastur the Unspeakable
monsters.description:
Its form is partially that of a reptile, partially that of a gigantic
octopus. It will destroy you.

monsters.name: Ar-Pharazon the Golden
monsters.description:
Last and proudest king of ancient Numenor. Corrupted by power and
avarice, he fell victim to Sauron's wiles, tried to fight the immortals
themselves, and condemned Numenor to oblivion.

monsters.name: Nyogtha, the Thing that Should not Be
monsters.description:
"...a little finger of blackness crept out from beneath its edge
a great wave of iridescent blackness, neither liquid nor solid,
a frightful gelatinous mass."

monsters.name: Ahtu, Avatar of Nyarlathotep
monsters.description:
"Higher already than the giants of the forest ringing it, the
fifty-foot-thick column... sprouted a ring of tendrils, ruddy and
golden and glittering overall with inclusions of quartz."

monsters.name: Fundin Bluecloak
monsters.description:
He is one of the greatest dwarven priests to walk the earth. Fundin has
earned a high position in the church, and his skill with both weapon and
spell only justify his position further. His combination of both dwarven
strength and priestly wisdom are a true match for any adventurer.

monsters.name: The Philosophy Teacher
monsters.description:
She is a feared teacher, mistress of chaos and strangely minded.
She wants to take your mind. Fear her and flee while you can.

monsters.name: Dwar, Dog Lord of Waw
monsters.description:
Dwar had a special affinity for dogs in life, and can still command them
at will. He howls manically as he reaches out to destroy you.

monsters.name: Sea serpent
monsters.description:
A huge snake-like reptile with scales coloured like the sea in
which it dwells.

monsters.name: Hand druj
monsters.description:
A skeletal hand floating in the air, motionless except for its flexing
fingers.

monsters.name: Grand master mystic
monsters.description:
He is one of the few true masters of the art, being extremely skillful in
all forms of unarmed combat and controlling the world's natural creatures
with disdainful ease.

monsters.name: True believer
monsters.description:
True master of unbelievers, genuine master of weaponry with his Dark Sword,
no one dares utter a so-called 'mystic' word in front of him.

monsters.name: Greater titan
monsters.description:
A forty foot tall humanoid that shakes the ground as it walks. The power
radiating from its frame shakes your courage, its hatred inspired by your
defiance.

monsters.name: Baphomet the Minotaur Lord
monsters.description:
A fearsome bull-headed monster, Baphomet swings a mighty axe as he curses
all that defy him.

monsters.name: Eye druj
monsters.description:
A bloodshot eyeball floating in the air, you'd be forgiven for assuming it
harmless.

monsters.name: Daoloth, the Render of the Veils
monsters.description:
"Not shapeless, but so complex that the eye could recognize no
describable shape. There were hemispheres and shining metal,
coupled by long plastic rods. The rods were of a flat gray color,
so that he could not make out which were nearer; they merged into
a flat mass from which protruded individual cylinders. As he looked
at it, he had a curious feeling that eyes gleamed from between
these rods; but wherever he glanced at the construction, he saw
only the spaces between them."

monsters.name: Shudde M'ell
monsters.description:
The most powerful and most evil of all Chthonians.
"A great gray thing a mile long chanting and exuding strange acids...
charging through the depths of the earth at a fantastic speed, in a
dreadful fury... melting basaltic rocks like butter under a blowtorch."

monsters.name: Skull druj
monsters.description:
A glowing skull possessed by sorcerous power. It need not move, but
merely blast you with mighty magic.

monsters.name: Artsi, the Champion of Chaos
monsters.description:
He is one of the greatest warriors of chaos to walk the earth.
His bloody blade has slain thousands and tens of thousands, and still
hungers for more.

monsters.name: Hound of Tindalos
monsters.description:
"They are lean and athirst!... All the evil in the universe
was concentrated in their lean, hungry bodies. Or had they
bodies? I saw them only for a moment, I cannot be certain."

monsters.name: Jack of Shadows
monsters.description:
Deriving his strength from the shadows, this king of thieves
steals only for the challenge.

monsters.name: Lord of Chaos
monsters.description:
He is one of the few true masters of the art, being extremely skillful in
all forms of unarmed combat and controlling the Chaos with disdainful ease.

monsters.name: Saruman of Many Colours
monsters.description:
Originally known as the White, Saruman fell prey to Sauron's wiles. He
searches forever for the One Ring, to become a mighty Sorcerer-King of the
world.

monsters.name: Greater kraken
monsters.description:
An enormously fearsome and powerful inhabitant of the depths. It
resembles a gargantuan octopus and its evil is almost tangible.

monsters.name: Experienced spirit
monsters.description: A helpful spirit from beyond the grave.

monsters.name: Gandalf the Grey
monsters.description:
The wizard who opposed Sauron and, in the end, was the only
one of the Istari to succeed in his task. Gandalf is very
wise and specializes in fire magic.

monsters.name: Bronze dragonrider
monsters.description: A Dragonrider of Pern, mightiest among the males.

monsters.name: Thrain, the King Under the Mountain
monsters.description: He must have suffered horrible tortures...

monsters.name: Grand swordsmaster
monsters.description: A warrior of considerable skill. Really considerable.

monsters.name: Cave gorm
monsters.description:
A terrifying, large reptile in black scales, burning the earth with
the touch of hell where it steps. It seems impossible to impede it.

monsters.name: Nightwing
monsters.description:
Everywhere colours seem paler and the air chiller. At the centre of the
cold stands a mighty figure. Its wings envelop you in the chill of death
as the nightwing reaches out to draw you into oblivion. Your muscles sag
and your mind loses all will to fight as you stand in awe of this mighty
being.

monsters.name: Bile demon
monsters.description:
It's big. It's fat. It's red. It's ugly. It's got a severe attack of
highly poisonous flatulence. And its insides are corrosive. All of which
go together to make the single most repulsive sight - and smell - you have
ever experienced.

monsters.name: Uriel, Angel of Fire
monsters.description:
A creature of godly appearance, you dare not challenge Uriel's supremacy.
Those who stood against him before are but a memory, cremated by his
mastery of elemental fire.

monsters.name: Dolphiner
monsters.description:
The Dolphiners came with the Dragonriders from the far planet Pern.
These friendly beings ride their dolphins into combat to assist you.

monsters.name: Bone golem
monsters.description:
A skeletal form, black as night, constructed from the bones of its
previous victims.

monsters.name: Azriel, Angel of Death
monsters.description:
Azriel commands awesome power, his visage holy enough to shrivel your
soul. You shriek with disbelief as his mastery of death draws you to your
grave. It is truly beyond all but the mightiest of warriors to stand
against him and live.

monsters.name: Dreadlord
monsters.description:
It is a massive form of animated death, its colour deeper than black. It
drinks in light, and space around it is twisted and torn by the weight of
its evil. It is unlife and it knows nothing but the stealing of souls and
the stench of death. Flee its hunger!

monsters.name: The Physics Teacher
monsters.description:
A keeper of forbidden wisdom, this Teacher bombards you with his mastery
over elements of matter.

monsters.name: Mumak
monsters.description: A massive elephantine form with eyes twisted by madness.

monsters.name: Great storm wyrm
monsters.description:
A vast dragon of power. Storms and lightning crash around its titanic
form. Deep blue scales reflect the flashes and highlight the creature's
great muscles. It regards you with contempt.

monsters.name: Great ice wyrm
monsters.description:
An immense dragon capable of awesome destruction. You have never felt
such extreme cold, or witnessed such an icy stare. Begone quickly or feel
its wrath!

monsters.name: Great swamp wyrm
monsters.description:
A truly enormous dragon with great powers. The foul gases issuing
from the beast nearly make you vomit; and while you may try to hold
your breath as you fight it, it sees no reason to do likewise.

monsters.name: Great wyrm of perplexity
monsters.description:
A dragon of great size and power. Its polished bronze scales reflect the
light in strange and confusing patterns, and you find it hard to keep your
mind on the job of fighting for your life.

monsters.name: Keeper of Secrets
monsters.description:
This demonic keeper of forbidden secrets looks like a hairless
minotaur with extra arms, decorated with tattoos and nose rings.
It is the embodiment of Slaanesh's perverted magic.

monsters.name: Gabriel, the Messenger
monsters.description:
Commanding a legion of angels, Gabriel will destroy you for your sins. He
will crush you like the pitiful insignificant being he sees you to be.
Your very soul will be taken into judgement by his supreme authority as he
cleanses the world of evil.

monsters.name: Archlich
monsters.description:
A lich who has reached its ultimate evolutionary stage: a completely
immaterial state.

monsters.name: Hoarmurath of Dir
monsters.description:
A Ringwraith powerful in fell sorcery, he yearns for the life he has
exchanged for an unlife of everlasting torment.

monsters.name: Osyluth
monsters.description:
It is a demon made almost entirely out of bones. It is humanoid, but with
a large tail similar to that of a giant scorpion, and emits a foul smell
of decay and rot. They are despised even in the hells.

monsters.name: Chaos hound
monsters.description:
A constantly changing canine form, this hound rushes towards you as if
expecting mayhem and chaos ahead. It appears to have an almost kamikaze
relish for combat. You suspect all may not be as it seems.

monsters.name: Bronze golem
monsters.description: A gigantic four-armed animated bronze statue, glowing with great heat.

monsters.name: Great wyrm of radiance
monsters.description:
A dragon of great size and power. Its polished silver scales reflect the
light in blinding brightness, and you find it hard to keep your
mind on the job of fighting for your life.

monsters.name: Hru
monsters.description: A rock giant, a being made of living stone.

monsters.name: The Cat Lord
monsters.description: Master of all things feline, the Cat Lord moves with catlike stealth.

monsters.name: Horned serpent
monsters.description:
A huge snake-like reptile with redish scales and horns,
rarely encountered it inhabits swamps, mountains and caves.

monsters.name: Thuringwethil, the Vampire Messenger
monsters.description:
Chief messenger between Sauron and Morgoth, she is the most deadly of her
vampire race on Middle-earth. At first she is charming to meet, but her
wings and eyes give away her true form.

monsters.name: Great hell wyrm
monsters.description:
A vast dragon of immense power. Fire leaps continuously from its huge
form. The air around it scalds you. Its slightest glance burns you, and
you realize how truly insignificant you are.

monsters.name: Beholder hive-mother
monsters.description:
A hive mother of the race of beholders, she can summon her brood to her aid
whenever she wishes.

monsters.name: Leviathan
monsters.description: An enormous, terrible sea-monster, the true master of the ocean.

monsters.name: Shambler
monsters.description:
This elemental creature is power incarnate; it looks like a huge polar bear
with a huge gaping maw instead of a head.

monsters.name: Glaaki
monsters.description:
"From an oval body protruded countless thin, pointed spines of
multi-colored metal; at the more rounded end of the oval a
circular, thick-lipped mouth formed the center of a spongy
face, from which rose three yellow eyes on thin stalks. Around
the underside of the body were many white pyramids, presumably
used for locomotion. The diameter of the body must have been
at least ten feet at its least wide..."

monsters.name: Great bile wyrm
monsters.description:
A huge and very powerful dragon. Great steaming pools of acid drip from
its form onto the ground. You shudder when you see the acid eating away
the very stones of the dungeon - what could it do to you?

monsters.name: Great wyrm of thunder
monsters.description:
A dragon of gigantic proportions, with destructive abilities to match. The
sheer loudness of its roar leaves you stunned and unable to think clearly
enough to defend yourself adequately.

monsters.name: Hypnos, Lord of Sleep
monsters.description:
"Young with the youth that is outside time, and with a handsome
bearded face, curved, smiling lips, Olympian brow; and dense locks
waving and poppy-crowned."

monsters.name: Jabberwock
monsters.description:
"Beware the Jabberwock, my son! The jaws that bite, the claws that catch!"
Run and run quickly, for death incarnate chases behind you!

monsters.name: Tselakus, the Dreadlord
monsters.description:
This huge affront to existence twists and tears at the fabric of space.
Darkness itself recoils from the touch of Tselakus as he leaves a trail
of death and destruction. Mighty claws rend reality as he
annihilates all in his path to your soul!

monsters.name: Nightcrawler
monsters.description:
This intensely evil creature bears the form of a gargantuan black worm.
Its gaping maw is a void of blackness, acid drips from its steely hide.
It is like nothing you have ever seen before, and a terrible chill runs
down your spine as you face it.

monsters.name: Gelugon
monsters.description:
This demon from the ice planes is a truly terrifying sight. It has an
extremely large, insect-like body towering a full twelve feet tall, with
great claws on its hands and pincers on its mouth, and its head bulges
with great multi-faceted eyes. Its tail is covered with razor-sharp
spikes.

monsters.name: Polyphemus, the Blind Cyclops
monsters.description:
No ordinary cyclops, but the son of a sea-god: he wields the powers of
elemental water as well as the considerable strength of a cyclops. His
one eye was blinded long ago by the warrior Odysseus, but he has trained
himself to hear so well that it nearly makes up for his disability.

monsters.name: Smaug the Golden
monsters.description:
Smaug is one of the Uruloki that still survive, a fire-drake of immense
cunning and intelligence. His speed through air is matched by few other
dragons, his dragonfire is what legends are made of, and his hide is
armoured with diamonds: he is believed to be the greatest dragon still
surviving into the Third Age.

monsters.name: Glaurung, Father of the Dragons
monsters.description:
Glaurung is the father of all dragons, and was for a long time the most
powerful. Though this is no longer so, he still has full command over
his brood and can command them to appear whenever he so wishes. He is
the definition of dragonfire.

monsters.name: The Norsa
monsters.description:
An elephantine horror with five trunks, each capable of breathing
destructive blasts. It is said that it is better to face the fury
of a thousand raging lions than the Norsa!

monsters.name: Rhan-Tegoth
monsters.description:
"An almost globular torso, with six long, sinuous limbs terminating
in crab-like claws. From the upper end a subsidiary globe bulged
forward bubble-like; its triangle of three staring, fishy eyes,
its foot-long and evidently flexible proboscis, and a distended
lateral system analogous to gills, suggested that it was a head."

monsters.name: Bouncing mine
monsters.description: It was left here to be used against intruders.

monsters.name: Gold dragonrider
monsters.description: A Dragonrider of Pern, among the queens of their kind.

monsters.name: Zeus, the Omnipotent
monsters.description:
The omnipotent God of the Gods, resides in the Parnassus
and rules the world - but 'it' is also known for its vigor
and lasciviousness.

monsters.name: Tiamat, Celestial Dragon of Evil
monsters.description:
Usually found guarding the first plane of Hell, Tiamat is a formidable
opponent, her five heads breathing death to all who stand against her.

monsters.name: Sky blade
monsters.description:
An undeviable presence, designated to watch the skies and maintain their
balance. Its aura is pure beyond expression, its eyes reflect supreme laws
beyond comprehension, daring to look at it will drive you insane, let alone
fighting it!

monsters.name: Greater demonic quylthulg
monsters.description: A massive pulsating mound of flesh, glowing with an inner hellish light.

monsters.name: Greater draconic quylthulg
monsters.description:
A massive mound of scaled flesh, throbbing and pulsating with multi-hued
light.

monsters.name: Greater rotting quylthulg
monsters.description:
A massive pile of rotting flesh. A disgusting stench fills the air as it
throbs and writhes.

monsters.name: Ymir, the Ice Giant
monsters.description:
Ymir is one of the oldest beings in existence. He looks like a giant
humanoid made of ice.

monsters.name: Surtur, the Fire Giant
monsters.description:
Surtur is another of the most ancient of all creatures. He is a demonic
giant of fire, who is destined to set the nine worlds afire with his
accursed sword of doom on the day of Ragnarok.

monsters.name: War
monsters.description:
One of the horsemen of the apocalypse, before you lies War. A healthy and
hearty warrior, War grins a little too wide at you as he prepares for
combat. War rides a large well-groomed yellow horse that leaves behind
puddles of blood where its hooves touch the ground.

monsters.name: Great dragon of bad luck
monsters.description:
A huge and very powerful dragon. Great steaming pools of acid drip from
its form onto the ground. You shudder when you see the acid eating away
the very stones of the dungeon - what could it do to you?

monsters.name: T'ron, the Rebel Dragonrider
monsters.description:
As the Dragonriders came from Pern to help the elves, T'ron and his rebel
Dragonwing came to defend Morgoth! He is an evil and powerful Dragonrider.

monsters.name: Horned reaper
monsters.description:
A giant humanoid demon wielding a massive, heavy and sharp scythe. Feared
by foes and friends alike when it flies into one of its berserk rages, the
Horned Reaper will cut down anything in its path between it and you - even
the minions it has just summoned.

monsters.name: Null, the Living Void
monsters.description: A black hole in the fabric of reality. It simply is not there.

monsters.name: Khamul, the Black Easterling
monsters.description:
A warrior-king of the East. Khamul is a powerful opponent, his skill in
combat awesome and his form twisted by evil cunning.

monsters.name: Mandragora
monsters.description:
A poisonous plant like a branched carrot, but it has a face similar
to man and it screams a deadly scream when one tries to pull it out.

monsters.name: Lord Jubei, the Legendary Swordsmaster
monsters.description:
Founder of the Yagyu school, maybe the greatest swordsman ever.
His left eye is covered by a patch, but there is no sign of any
weakness on this fighter.

monsters.name: Horned reaper
monsters.description:
A giant humanoid demon wielding a massive, heavy and sharp scythe. Feared
by foes and friends alike when it flies into one of its berserk rages, the
Horned Reaper will cut down anything in its path between it and you.

monsters.name: Nightwalker
monsters.description:
A huge giant garbed in black, more massive than a titan and stronger than
a dragon. With terrible blows, it breaks your armour from your back,
leaving you defenseless against its evil wrath. It can smell your fear,
and you in turn smell the awful stench of death as this ghastly figure
strides towards you menacingly.

monsters.name: Omarax the Eye Tyrant
monsters.description:
A beholder of great size and age, floating in the air. His gaze seems to
shred your soul and his spells crush your will. He is ancient, his history
steeped in forgotten evils, his atrocities numerous and sickening.

monsters.name: Atlach-Nacha, the Spider God
monsters.description:
"...there was a kind of face on the squat ebon body, low down amid
the several-jointed legs. The face peered up with a weird expression
of doubt and inquiry..."

monsters.name: Black reaver
monsters.description:
A humanoid form, black as night, advancing steadily and unstoppably, even
the very rock of the dungeon cannot prevent it reaching you.

monsters.name: Tsathoggua, the Sleeper of N'kai
monsters.description:
"...the formless bulking of a couchant mass. And the mass stirred
a little... and put forth with infinite slothfulness a huge and
toad-shaped head. And the head opened its eyes very slowly, as if
half awakened from slumber, so that they were visible as two slits
of oozing phosphor in the black browless face."

monsters.name: Aether hound
monsters.description:
A shifting, swirling form. It seems to be all colours and sizes and
shapes, though the dominant form is that of a huge dog. You feel very
uncertain all of a sudden.

monsters.name: Hela, Queen of the Dead
monsters.description:
The Norse ruler of Hel is a merciless queen, who ever hunts for more
souls to add to her collection of tortured spirits. She arrives in
an ominous green robe, a certain sign of impending doom, to claim
as her own those who die an ignoble death.

monsters.name: Pestilence
monsters.description:
One of the horsemen of the apocalypse, before you lies Pestilence.
At first, it looks like a human, but then you notice ants, worms, and
worse peeking out of the flesh. Pestilence rides a purple horse with
skin that bulges and occasionally gives hints of the vermin within.

monsters.name: Great wyrm of chaos
monsters.description:
A massive dragon of changing form. As you watch, it appears first fair
and then foul. Its body is twisted by chaotic forces as it strives to
stay real. Its very existence distorts the universe around it.

monsters.name: Great wyrm of law
monsters.description:
A massive dragon of powerful intellect. It seeks to dominate the universe
and despises all other life. It sees all who do not obey it as mere
insects to be crushed underfoot.

monsters.name: Mardra, rider of the Gold Loranth
monsters.description:
Former Weyrwomand of Fort Weyr, she and T'ron have fallen under the control
of Morgoth. Loranth, her dragon, can summon Dragonriders to her aid.

monsters.name: Ungoliant, the Unlight
monsters.description:
This enormous, hideous spirit of void is in the form of a spider of
immense proportions. She is surrounded by a cloud of Unlight as she sucks
in all living light into her bloated body, and breathes out the blackest of
darkness. She is always ravenously hungry and would even eat herself to
avoid starvation.

monsters.name: Y'golonac
monsters.description:
"He saw why the shadow on the frosted pane yesterday had been
headless and he screamed... but before he could scream out his
protest his breath was cut off, as the hands descended on his
face and the wed ret mouths opened in their palms."

monsters.name: The Serpent of Chaos
monsters.description:
Writhing coil upon coil, this mighty spawn of Chaos constantly disintegrates
and reforms before your dazzled eyes. It gazes balefully upon you with its
one remaining eye, and seeks to destroy you utterly.

monsters.name: The Shadow of Dol Guldur
monsters.description:
The dark master of the terrible fortress of southern Mirkwood. It is
rumoured that this is in fact none other than Sauron in disguise:
although if this is so, he has yet to reveal his full power - and perhaps
will not do so while his deception lasts, in the hope of keeping it going.

monsters.name: The Unicorn of Order
monsters.description:
The Unicorn of Order, who once stole an eye from the great Serpent
of Chaos, regards you as a mortal meddling in the affairs of immortals,
and thus is attempting to eliminate you.

monsters.name: Vlad Dracula, Prince of Darkness
monsters.description: The most feared of all vampires, the Prince of Darkness himself.

monsters.name: Yig, Father of Serpents
monsters.description:
"The half-human father of serpents... the snake-god of the central
plains tribes -- presumably the primal source of the more
southerly Quetzalcoatl or Kukulcan -- was odd, half-anthropomorphic
devil."

monsters.name: Master quylthulg
monsters.description: A giant seething mass of flesh, overwhelming you with monster after monster.

monsters.name: Atlas, the Titan
monsters.description:
The strongest of all the Titans. Legend has it that he once held the sky
on his shoulders; and the mountain range that now does so is named after him.

monsters.name: Sky drake
monsters.description: The mightiest elemental dragon of air, it can destroy you with ease.

monsters.name: Feagwath, the Undead Sorcerer
monsters.description:
A stench of corruption and decay surrounds this sorcerer, who has clearly
risen from the dead to continue his foul plots and schemes.

monsters.name: Pit fiend
monsters.description:
Appearing as a giant, clawed and winged humanoid with a scaly red body
