and massive fangs dripping a foul green liquid, the Pit Fiend is a
dreadful enemy from the lowest depths of the hells. They are often the
commanders of vast demon armies.

monsters.name: Unmaker
monsters.description:
Spawned from the Pits of the Abyss, it is a mass of sentient Chaos,
spreading uncontrollably and destroying everything in its path.

monsters.name: Cyberdemon
monsters.description:
Reverbrant metal steps announce the arrival of this huge creature,
half demon half machine. It has an unsurpassable firepower.

monsters.name: Fenris Wolf
monsters.description:
The immensely huge wolf who would swallow the sun to satisfy its
hunger - and leave the gods for dessert.

monsters.name: Famine
monsters.description:
One of the horsemen of the apocalypse, before you lies Famine. A
figure so gaunt that the shape of the bones beneath are revealed,
Famine rides a pale grey mare that appears near death.

monsters.name: Lord Ken, Fist of the North Star
monsters.description:
When your meridian points have been struck in the shape of the big dipper,
you are already dead.

monsters.name: The Mouth of Sauron
monsters.description:
The Mouth of Sauron is a mighty spell caster. So old that even he cannot
remember his own name, his power and evil are undeniable. He believes
unshakeably that he is unbeatable and laughs as he weaves his awesome
spells.

monsters.name: Lessa, rider of the Gold Ramoth
monsters.description: The Weyrwomand of the Weyr of Benden, she came to help you.

monsters.name: Cthugha, the Living Flame
monsters.description:
"But even though we had shielded our eyes, it was impossible not
to see the great amorphous shpaes streaming skyward from the
accursed place, nor the equally great being hovering like a cloud
of living fire above the trees."

monsters.name: Black dog
monsters.description: It is a giant nocturnal spectre, a portent of death, with large glowing eyes.

monsters.name: Hrungnir, the Stone Giant
monsters.description:
Hrungnir is the strongest of all the Stone Giants: one who would even dare
to challenge Thor himself to single combat.

monsters.name: Thiazi, the Storm Giant
monsters.description:
Thiazi is the greatest of all the Storm Giants: when travelling, he takes
the form of a giant eagle. It was he who succeeded in kidnapping Iduna and
her apples of youth from Asgard itself.

monsters.name: Qlzqqlzuup, the Lord of Flesh
monsters.description:
A gigantic seething mass of flesh, Qlzqqlzuup changes colours in front
of your eyes. Pulsating first one colour then the next, it knows only it
must bring help to protect itself.

monsters.name: F'lar, rider of the Bronze Mnementh
monsters.description:
The Weyrleader of Benden Weyr on Pern, he has come with Lessa to help you in
your battle. Having already saved Pern, he now wants to save Arda!

monsters.name: Great wyrm of balance
monsters.description:
A massive dragon, it is thousands of
years old and seeks to maintain the Cosmic Balance. It sees you as an
upstart troublemaker without the wisdom to control your actions.

monsters.name: Great wyrm of many colours
monsters.description: A huge dragon whose scales shimmer in myriad hues.

monsters.name: Greater balrog
monsters.description:
Originally of the semi-divine Maiar, this evil spirit swore allegiance
to Morgoth at the beginning of time and is now one of his most terrible
demonic servants. With its flaming whip and sword it seeks to destroy you.

monsters.name: Cyaegha
monsters.description:
"...it was a gigantic eye staring down at them. Around the eye,
the sky split; deep clefts opened through which the darkness
began to ooze, a darkness blacker than the night, which crawled
down as a set of slimy tentacles, taking on more form, more
definite shape... something was standing, outlined against
the black sky, something which had tentacles of darkness
and a green-glowing eye."

monsters.name: Death
monsters.description:
The leader of the horsemen of the apocalypse, before you lies Death.
A bony skeleton in a huge dark robe wielding a great scythe, Death rides
a horse of purest black and comes to bring your death.

monsters.name: The Witch-King of Angmar
monsters.description:
The Chief of the Ringwraiths. A fell being of devastating power. His
spells are lethal and his combat blows crushingly hard. He moves at
speed, and commands legions of evil to do his bidding. It is said that he
is fated never to die by the hand of mortal man.

monsters.name: Death orb
monsters.description: A small, apparently unassuming orb which spawns death and destruction.

monsters.name: Solar blade
monsters.description:
An undeviable presence, designated to watch sun, earth and moon and maintain
their balance. Its aura is pure beyond expression, its eyes reflect supreme
laws beyond comprehension, daring to look at it will drive you insane, let
alone fighting it!

monsters.name: Maeglin, the Traitor of Gondolin
monsters.description:
The son of Eol the Dark-Elf, Maeglin is every bit as evil as his father
and more. His greed for gold led him to betray the Hidden Kingdom of
Gondolin to Morgoth's forces. He is a mighty warrior himself, and some
of Morgoth's greatest servants answer to his call.

monsters.name: Nodens, Lord of the Great Abyss
monsters.description:
The hoary Lord of the Great Abyss seems a wizened man,
but appearances can be deceiving.

monsters.name: Pazuzu, Lord of Air
monsters.description:
A winged humanoid demon from the Planes of Hell, Pazuzu grins inhumanely at
you as he decides your fate.

monsters.name: Ithaqua the Windwalker
monsters.description:
The Wendigo, moving so fast that you can see little except two
glowing eyes burning with hatred.

monsters.name: Pirotessa, Succubus Empress
monsters.description:
Direct descendant of Lucifer, mother of Glaryssa, all angels seeking
to destroy her fell to her serpent kiss.

monsters.name: Draugluin, Sire of All Werewolves
monsters.description:
Draugluin provides Sauron with a fearsome personal guard. He is an
enormous wolf inhabited by a human spirit. He is chief of all his kind.

monsters.name: Cantoras, the Skeletal Lord
monsters.description:
A legion of evil undead druj animating the skeleton of a once mighty
sorcerer. His power is devastating and his speed unmatched in the
underworld. Flee his wrath!

monsters.name: Mephistopheles, Lord of Hell
monsters.description: A duke of hell, in the flesh.

monsters.name: Godzilla
monsters.description:
Godzilla rose from the contaminated sea. This terrible creature could
level whole cities in anger.

monsters.name: The Tarrasque
monsters.description:
The Tarrasque is a massive reptile of legend, rumoured to be unkillable
and immune to magic. Fear its anger, for its devastation is unmatched!

monsters.name: Abhoth, Source of Uncleanness
monsters.description:
"...in the pool [there was] a grayish, horrid mass that nearly choked
it from rim to rim. Here, it seemed, was the ultimate source of all
miscreation and abomination. For the gray mass quobbed and quivered,
and swelled perpetually; and from it, in manifold fission, were
spawned the anatomies that crept away on every side through the
grotto."

monsters.name: Loki, the Trickster
monsters.description:
Loki, the god of mischief, is a nasty person. He will use every
dirty trick in the book, and then some. In the end, his half-giant
heritage is bound to show, as he will defect to the side of the
giants and fight against the other gods of Asgard.

monsters.name: Great wyrm of power
monsters.description:
The mightiest of all dragonkind, a great wyrm of power is seldom
encountered in our world. It can crush stars with its might.

monsters.name: Huan, Wolfhound of the Valar
monsters.description:
The wolfhound of the Valar, Huan has served many masters in his time, from
Celegorm son of Feanor to Beren son of Barahir: but now he runs wild and
acknowledges no master save himself, as he hunts alone for his nemesis -
Carcharoth, the terrible wolf of Angband.

monsters.name: Star-spawn of Cthulhu
monsters.description:
The last remnants of sanity threaten to leave your brain as you
behold this titanic bat-winged, octopus-headed unholy abomination.
"They all lay in stone houses in their great city of R'lyeh,
preserved by the spells of mighty Cthulhu for a glorious
resurrection when the stars and the earth might once more
be ready..."

monsters.name: Carcharoth, the Jaws of Thirst
monsters.description:
The first guard of Angband, Carcharoth, also known as 'The Red Maw', is
the largest wolf to ever walk the earth. He is highly intelligent and a
deadly opponent in combat.

monsters.name: Kronos, Lord of the Titans
monsters.description:
The lord of the Titans, he has broken loose from his confinement in
the nether hells to seek revenge on the world.

monsters.name: Lungorthin, the Balrog of White Fire
monsters.description:
A massive form cloaked in flame. Lungorthin stares balefully at you with
eyes that smoulder red. The dungeon floor where he stands is scorched by
the heat of his body.

monsters.name: Shuma-Gorath
monsters.description:
Shuma-Gorath is one of the immortal lords of chaos. The true form of
this blasphemous horror is a huge, all-seeing eye surrounded by tentacles.

monsters.name: Tulzscha, the Green Flame
monsters.description:
"A belching column of sick greenish flame... spouting volcanically
from the depths profound and inconceivable, casting no shadows as
healthy flame should, and coating the nitrous stone with a nasty,
venomous verdigris. For all that seething combustion no warmth
lay, but only the clamminess of death and corruption."

monsters.name: Oremorj, the Cyberdemon Lord
monsters.description: The mightiest of Cyberdemons, their lord and ruler.

monsters.name: Ancalagon the Black
monsters.description:
"Rushing Jaws" is his name, and death is his game; the greatest and most
terrible of all dragonkind, his power dismayed even the Valar for a time.

monsters.name: Yog-Sothoth, the All-in-One
monsters.description:
"Great globes of light massing towards the opening... the breaking
apart of the nearest globes, and the protoplasmic flesh that
flowed blackly outward to join together and form that eldritch,
hideous horror from outer space... whose mask was a congeries
of iridescent globes... who froths as primal slime in nuclear
chaos forever beyond the nethermost outposts of space and time!"

monsters.name: Wise spirit
monsters.description: A helpful spirit from beyond the grave.

monsters.name: Star blade
monsters.description:
An undeviable presence, designated to watch the stars and the void and
maintain their balance. Its aura is pure beyond expression, its eyes reflect
supreme laws beyond comprehension, daring to look at it will drive you insane,
let alone fighting it!

monsters.name: Shub-Niggurath, Black Goat of the Woods
monsters.description:
This horrendous outer god looks like a writhing cloudy mass filled
with mouths and tentacles.

monsters.name: Vecna, the Emperor Lich
monsters.description:
The greatest of all undead sorcerers, even the gods once feared him. This
ancient shadow of death wilts every living thing it passes.

monsters.name: Nyarlathotep, the Crawling Chaos
monsters.description:
Nyarlathothep is the messenger, the heart and the soul of the outer gods.
He is a shapechanger capable of assuming thousands of nightmarish forms.
One of them looks like this: "A tall, slim figure with the young face of
an antique pharaoh, gay with prismatic robes and crowned with a
pshent that glowed with inherent light... the fascination of a
dark god or fallen archangel, and around whose eyes there lurked
the languid sparkle of capricious humor."

monsters.name: Azathoth, the Daemon Sultan
monsters.description:
"That last amorphous blight of nethermost confusion which
blasphemes and bubbles at the centre of all infinity --
the boundless daemon sultan Azathoth, whose name no lips
dare speak aloud, and who gnaws hungrily in inconceivable,
unlighted chambers beyond time amidst the muffled, maddening
beating of vile drums and the thin monotonous whine of
accursed flutes."

monsters.name: Jormungand the Midgard Serpent
monsters.description:
The Midgard Serpent is so huge that its body surrounds the world of
mortal men. It could grind even the gods into lifeless pulp.

monsters.name: The Destroyer
monsters.description:
The Destroyer was built by the Norse deities to be their ultimate weapon
against the space gods who had arrived to judge the world. Unfortunately,
the Destroyer has gone berserk and is destroying everything it sees. The
mystical Destroyer is nearly indestructible, and it is said that when it
uses its power of complete disintegration, the day of Ragnarok is near.

monsters.name: Gothmog, the High Captain of Balrogs
monsters.description:
Gothmog is the Chief Balrog in Morgoth's personal guard. He is renowned
for slaying three High Kings of the Noldor Elves, and he has never been
defeated in combat. With his whip of flame and awesome fiery breath he
saved his master from Ungoliant's rage.

monsters.name: Old possessor (soul)
monsters.description: It does not look that powerful.

monsters.name: The Greater Lag Monster
monsters.description:
It is even worse than the RNG, coming from Mangband,
it seeks to crush you to pulp... and surely can.

monsters.name: Tzeentch, the Changer of Ways
monsters.description:
"Do not ask which creature screams in the night. Do not question who waits for
you in the shadow. It is my cry that wakes you in the night, and my body that
crouches in the shadow. I am Tzeentch and you are the puppet that dances to my
tune..."

monsters.name: Great Cthulhu
monsters.description:
This creature is death incarnate. "A monster of vaguely anthropoid
outline, but with an octopus-like head whose face was a mass of
feelers, a scaly, rubbery-looking body, prodigious claws on hind
fore feet, and long, narrow wings behind. This thing... was a
somewhat bloated corpulence... It lumbered slobberingly into sight
and gropingly squeezed its gelatinous green immensity through the
black doorway... A mountain shambled or walked."

monsters.name: Sorka, rider of the Gold Faranth
monsters.description:
Faranth is the first Dragonrider queen, and Sorka the first to discover
the Fire-lizards, the ancestor of the Dragons of Pern. She will try to
help you!

monsters.name: Minion of Doom
monsters.description:
A spirit soldier of a vast army of corrupted souls
who will raid the world when the apocalypse begins.

monsters.name: Force vortex
monsters.description: A whirling maelstrom of force that will unleash powerful impact on you.

monsters.name: Nether vortex
monsters.description: A whirling anomaly of nether mists that will drain your life force.

monsters.name: Nether guard
monsters.description:
Bound to guard the nether realm that no being that does not belong here would
ever set foot in it. The metallic green skin of this tall humanoid creature
is hard as adamantine, its four arms end in blades covered by intense plasma
discharges, making them flash blue and white, while instead of legs and feet
there is only smoke and flashes of light that seem to solidify and materialize
to the torso. Three wide black eyes, empty except for reflections of unknown
stars, surveye everything.

monsters.name: Michael, the Guardian Overlord
monsters.description:
Through many succeeding cycles of time, as ray after ray provided the pathway
for the descent of new spirits, lord Michael has remained as the guardian
overlord of the angelic host, the elemental kingdom and humanity. He shall
not fold his cosmic wings about him to return home until the final angelic
being is freed, the last man is redeemed and the last elemental returned to
its perfect state.

monsters.name: Ironwing
monsters.description:
An artificial bird completely made of hardened iron, kept in the air by
magical forces. Rather than a weapon it is a drone to scout intruders
and render their powers useless, making them easy prey. This animated,
enormously massive piece of metal is nearly impossible to destroy.

monsters.name: Sauron, the Sorcerer
monsters.description:
Mighty in spells and enchantments, he created the One Ring.
His eyes glow with power and with his gaze he seeks to destroy
your soul. He has many servants, and rarely fights without them.

monsters.name: Brightlance
monsters.description:
An undeviable presence, designated to watch the entrance gate of Valinor.
Its aura is pure beyond expression, its eyes reflect supreme laws
beyond comprehension, daring to look at it will drive you insane,
let alone fighting it!

monsters.name: Test blob
monsters.description: For testing

monsters.name: Morgoth, Lord of Darkness
monsters.description:
He was the most powerful of the Valar, the equal of Manwe.
He is the Master of the Pits of Angband. His figure is like a black
mountain crowned with Lightning. He rages with everlasting anger, his
body scarred by Fingolfin's eight mighty wounds. He can never rest from
his pain, but seeks forever to dominate all that is light and good in the
world. He is the origin of man's fear of darkness and created many foul
creatures with his evil powers. Orcs, Dragons, and Trolls are his most
foul corruptions, causing much pain and suffering in the world to please
him. His disgusting visage, twisted with evil, is crowned with iron, the
two remaining Silmarils forever burning him. Grond, the mighty Hammer of
the Underworld, cries defiance as he strides towards you to crush you to a
pulp!

monsters.name: Filthy street urchin
monsters.description: He looks squalid and thoroughly revolting.

monsters.name: Sparrow
monsters.description: Utterly harmless, except when angry.

monsters.name: Scruffy little dog
monsters.description: A thin flea-ridden mutt, growling as you get close.

monsters.name: Blubbering idiot
monsters.description: He tends to blubber a lot.

monsters.name: Boil-covered wretch
monsters.description: Ugly doesn't begin to describe him.

monsters.name: Village idiot
monsters.description: Drooling and comical, but then, what do you expect?

monsters.name: Pitiful-looking beggar
monsters.description: You just can't help feeling sorry for him.

monsters.name: Mangy-looking leper
monsters.description: You feel it isn't safe to touch him.

monsters.name: Agent of the black market
monsters.description: He 'finds' new wares for the Black Market. From unwary adventurers...

monsters.name: Singing, happy drunk
monsters.description: He makes you glad to be sober.

monsters.name: Aimless-looking merchant
monsters.description:
The typical ponce around town, with purse jingling, and looking for more
amulets of adornment to buy.

monsters.name: Mean-looking mercenary
monsters.description: No job is too low for him.

monsters.name: Battle-scarred veteran
monsters.description: He doesn't take to strangers kindly.

monsters.name: DarkGod, the Mighty Coder of Hell
monsters.description:
He is the master of coding; none can match his skill. He created the
Variant Maintainer, the RNGs, and the software bugs. Bull Gates is
nothing next to him. Do not think that since he loves the novels of
Pern he is to be ignored! He wishes to translate your soul into
assembler, the one hitch being that he must kill you first. If you
encounter him, pray your deity holds you in good stead.

monsters.name: Marylene, Heartbreakeress of the Netherworld
monsters.description:
A woman of mind-shattering beauty, none can match her beauty. She is perfect,
and totally evil. She loves nothing but herself and her evilness is as
great as her beauty. No one can stand against her, even DarkGod.
As you see her approaching, you feel your heart breaking.
She is the perfection, don't even try against her; you will surely lose
your mind...

monsters.name: Tik'srvzllat
monsters.description:
A disembodied and barely sentient mind, Tik'srvzllat floated
through the void for eons before being awakened by sorcery, pulled
into the nether realm, and shaped into the being you see before you.
A flickering purple outline of a sphere, with eerie yellow-purple
mist circling rapidly around it, Tik'srvzllat threatens your sanity
with its appearance alone.

monsters.name: Improv, the mighty MoLD
monsters.description:
An assistant to Dark God, Improv has chosen the form of a dense
purple smog for his incarnation into Middle Earth. It travels the
dungeons, killing software bugs and creating random artifacts for
guests to find.

monsters.name: The Mad Balancer
monsters.description:
The coder who keeps balancing this game like there is no tomorrow.
Make sure you have downloaded the latest scripts, or he will drive
you to despair!

monsters.name: The Evil Administrator from Hell
monsters.description:
A huge disembodied eye. As you stare into the black nothingness of its pupil,
you feel your will and vitality draining away, and are unable to do anything
except approach it in horrified fascination.

monsters.name: The Great Pumpkin
monsters.description:
On Halloween night, the Great Pumpkin rises out of its pumpkin patch
and flies through the air with its bag of loot for all the adventurers!

monsters.name: The Great Pumpkin
monsters.description:
On Halloween night, the Great Pumpkin rises out of its pumpkin patch
and flies through the air with its bag of loot for all the adventurers!

monsters.name: The Great Pumpkin
monsters.description:
On Halloween night, the Great Pumpkin rises out of its pumpkin patch
and flies through the air with its bag of loot for all the adventurers!

monsters.name: Santa Claus
monsters.description:
A fat and jolly otherworldly being, hoarder of many loot. He
challenges other travellers to take what he managed to pilfer
throughout the Middle-earth.

monsters.name: Invisible dummy
monsters.description:
Just a dummy placeholder for making grids inaccessible
to means such as teleport.

monsters.name: Bahamut, the Platinum King
monsters.description:
This revered dragon deity has a long, sinuous shape covered in silver-white
scales that sparkle and gleam even in the dimmest light. Bahamut's catlike
eyes are deep blue, as azure as a midsummer sky, some say. Others insist
that Bahamut's eyes are a frosty indigo, like the heart of a glacier.
While stern and disapproving of evil, he has no tolerance for any intruders.

monsters.name: The Living Lightning
monsters.description:
On the top-most shreds of the highest clouds in the bright seas of sky there
is an untamed, huge, crackling ball of energy, zapping around at blinding
speed, showing no signs of depletion but continuously firing powerful magical
and electrical discharges into all directions.

monsters.name: Star test blob
monsters.description: For testing

monsters.name: Blinky star test blob
monsters.description: For testing

monsters.name: Loot test blob
monsters.description: For testing

monsters.name: guy in blue robes
monsters.description:
A strange guy in blue clothes, speaking with an unknown foreign accent.
He looks around with an odd mixture of annoyance, surprise and impatience and
mutters unintelligibly about 'fixing' bugs of some sort, a collector maybe.
The only thing he fears are bug reports reflected from his own code by players.

monsters.name: mirror image
monsters.description:
Upon shattering the grand mirror, the adventurer's image suddenly came to
life! Showing no hesitation, empathy or doubt it attacked immediately!

monsters.name: Annoying test blob
monsters.description: For testing

monsters.name: Annoying immune test blob
monsters.description: For testing

monsters.name: Arrowing test blob
monsters.description: For testing

monsters.name: Shooting test blob
monsters.description: For testing

monsters.name: Bolting test blob
monsters.description: For testing

monsters.name: Missiling test blob
monsters.description: For testing

monsters.name: Shrieking test blob
monsters.description: For testing

monsters.name: Disintegrating test blob
monsters.description: For testing

monsters.name: The Hellraiser
monsters.description:
A remotely humanoid creature with four arms ending in claws and a demonic
head with its facial features unchanging, making it seem much like a golem.
Awakened on the hell forge, the body is gleaming in tones of dark red as
heated iron. Imbued by corrupt magic to call forth ultimate terror, its
gaze will sap your life forces and make you lose all grip on sanity.

monsters.name: Dor
monsters.description:
This golem beholder is a perfect sentry and won't let anything come close.
White mouldy flesh covered by metal plating holds a black lidless eye,
slowly turning around and around forever.

monsters.name: Zu-Aon, the Cosmic Border Guard
monsters.description:
Guarding the border between outer dimensions and the mundane cosmos
this being has a clear mission. Its patience seems to be infinite,
and its appearance doesn't reveal if this creature is actually alive
or some sort of construct or non-living avatar. Its powers seem to be
great enough to even hold back banished gods, and while its assignment
probably lasts a cosmos' lifetime, its paycheck remains unknown.

monsters.name: Orome, the Hunter
monsters.description:
The hunter might be the first to spot you on the shores of valinor.
How about returning his spear at the opportunity.
